table.name: ACADEMIC_TERMS
table.purpose: Dimension/lookup table of academic terms (one row per term, 1995–2030) at what appears to be MIT (IAP/January terms, SIS references). Each row describes a term's code, dates, academic year, and SIS status flags. Referenced by many course-offering, catalog, and library tables as the term key.

col_001.name: term_code
col_001.description: Primary key: term code in MIT format YYYYTT, e.g. 2010JA = January (IAP) Term 2010, 2023SU = Summer 2023, FA = Fall, SP = Spring. The year is the calendar year in which the term ends (fall term of 2009-2010 is coded 2010FA).

col_002.name: term_code_duplicate
col_002.description: Duplicate of col_001 (term code), stored a second time; joins 1:1 to ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.

col_003.name: term_name
col_003.description: Human-readable term name, e.g. 'January Term 2009-2010', 'Summer Term 2023'.

col_004.name: term_code_and_name
col_004.description: Concatenation of term code and term name, e.g. '2010JA-January Term 2009-2010'.

col_005.name: term_start_date
col_005.description: First day of the term (DD-MON-YY), e.g. 04-JAN-10 for January Term 2009-2010, 12-JUN-23 for Summer 2023.

col_006.name: term_end_date
col_006.description: Last day of the term (DD-MON-YY), e.g. 31-JAN-10 for January Term 2009-2010, 22-AUG-23 for Summer 2023.

col_007.name: term_calendar_year
col_007.description: Calendar year component of the term code (1995–2030); four terms per year.

col_008.name: academic_year_name
col_008.description: Academic year label containing the term, e.g. 'Academic Year 2009-2010' (fall 2009 through summer 2010).

col_009.name: is_current_term
col_009.description: Y/N flag marking the single current term as of the extract (only one 'Y' among 144 rows).

col_011.name: sis_term_status_code
col_011.description: SIS term status: C = current, P = previous, F = upcoming term (per ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER lookup); null for terms with no SIS status.

col_012.name: sis_term_status_name
col_012.description: Text label of the SIS term status: Current / Previous / Future / Unspecified (null status).

col_013.name: fiscal_year_start
col_013.description: Four-digit year, null ~12% of rows; e.g. 2023SU -> 2024, consistent with a July–June fiscal year. Likely fiscal year (start) the term falls in, but the exact fiscal-year convention is not directly evidenced.

col_014.name: fiscal_year_end
col_014.description: Same values and null pattern as col_013; likely the fiscal year (end) associated with the term. Identical to col_013 in all samples, so its distinct meaning is uncertain.

col_015.name: term_end_date_alt
col_015.description: A second end-of-term date, usually equal to or one day before col_006 (e.g. 29-JAN-10 vs end 31-JAN-10). The matching column in ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL (col_013) is likewise a date shortly before term end (e.g. 25-JAN-53 for Fall 1953, term end 31-JAN-53), suggesting end-of-classes or end-of-exams date, but the exact semantic remains unconfirmed.

col_016.name: preterm_date
col_016.description: Date shortly before the term starts (e.g. 01-DEC-09 for Jan 2010 term, 01-MAY-23 for Summer 2023), null ~4%. Plausibly a pre-registration or preparation deadline; exact meaning unresolved.

col_017.name: term_start_date_alt
col_017.description: Near-duplicate of the term start date (col_005); matches exactly for Spring/Summer terms and falls slightly earlier for Fall terms (e.g. 05-JAN-13 vs 07-JAN-13). The corresponding column in ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL (col_015) is documented as a start-of-classes date with the same pattern (two days before official term start for Fall, equal for Spring/Summer), supporting the reading of start of instruction/classes; still not directly evidenced, so an alternate reading (a second official start-date variant) also fits.

col_018.name: term_start_date_alt2
col_018.description: Another copy of the term start date (matches col_005 in samples), null when col_011 is null. Likely a third start-date variant; exact distinction from col_005/col_017 not evidenced.

col_019.name: term_close_date
col_019.description: Date at or just after term end (e.g. 01-FEB-10 for a term ending 31-JAN-10; 18-AUG-23 vs end 22-AUG-23). Plausibly a grade-submission or term-close deadline; exact meaning unresolved.

col_022.name: summer_session_start
col_022.description: Populated ~65% of rows; values cluster on 01-JUN (and some 01-SEP / mid-JAN). For Summer 2023 it is 01-JUN-23, before the 12-JUN-23 term start. Plausibly a session/period start date, but the pattern (including non-summer rows) is not fully explained.

col_023.name: summer_session_end
col_023.description: Companion to col_022 with identical null pattern; values cluster on 15-JAN and 31-AUG / 31-MAY. For Summer 2023 it is 31-AUG-23, after the 22-AUG-23 term end. Likely a session/period end date; exact meaning unresolved.

col_024.name: last_refresh_date
col_024.description: Constant value 19-DEC-24 on all rows — the date the table was last extracted/refreshed.

table.name: ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL
table.purpose: Dimension/lookup table of all MIT academic terms (Fall, Spring, Summer) from 1951 onward, with term codes, names, start/end dates, academic year, and SIS status flags. One row per term; referenced by many course, subject, and student tables as the term key.

col_001.name: term_code
col_001.description: Primary key: 6-character academic term code, YYYY + FA/SP/SU (e.g. 1953FA = Fall 1952-1953, 2016SU = Summer 2016).

col_002.name: term_code_duplicate
col_002.description: Duplicate of col_001 (term_code); identical values and join behavior, likely a second copy of the term code column.

col_003.name: term_name
col_003.description: Human-readable term name, e.g. 'Fall Term 1952-1953', 'Summer Term 2016'.

col_004.name: term_code_name
col_004.description: Concatenation of term code and term name, e.g. '1953FA-Fall Term 1952-1953'.

col_005.name: term_start_date
col_005.description: Official start date of the term (DD-MON-YY), e.g. Fall 1953 starts 19-SEP-52; Spring 1971 starts 03-FEB-71.

col_006.name: term_end_date
col_006.description: Official end date of the term (DD-MON-YY), e.g. Fall 1953 ends 31-JAN-53; Summer 2016 ends 16-AUG-16.

col_007.name: calendar_year
col_007.description: Calendar year of the term (the year in the term code), 1951-2030; 4 terms per year (FA/SP/SU plus one more per year, likely a January/IAP term).

col_008.name: academic_year_name
col_008.description: Academic year label containing the term, e.g. 'Academic Year 1952-1953' for Fall 1953 code; 4 terms share each academic year.

col_009.name: is_current_term
col_009.description: Y/N flag marking the single current term (only one row is 'Y').

col_010.name: sis_term_status
col_010.description: SIS term status code referencing ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER: C = SIS_CURRENT_TERM, P = SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM, F = SIS_UPCOMING_TERM. Most rows are 'P' (past terms); null for terms outside SIS scope.

col_011.name: fiscal_year_start
col_011.description: Year code (or 'XXXX' placeholder) appearing in pairs with col_012; likely fiscal-year or academic-year-related year value. Exact semantics unresolved; 'XXXX' used for older/summer terms. No join evidence available to disambiguate.

col_012.name: fiscal_year_end
col_012.description: Year code (or 'XXXX') paired with col_011; same values and null pattern, likely the second half of a year range. Exact semantics unresolved; no join evidence available to disambiguate.

col_013.name: term_end_date_alt
col_013.description: Date near the end of each term (e.g. 25-JAN-53 for Fall 1953 whose term end is 31-JAN-53). The mirrored column in ACADEMIC_TERMS (col_015) shows the same pattern: usually equal to or one day before the official term end date, suggesting an alternate official end such as end of instruction or a grade/registration cutoff, but the exact semantic remains unconfirmed.

col_015.name: classes_start_date
col_015.description: Start-of-classes date (e.g. 17-SEP-52, two days before the official term start 19-SEP-52 for Fall 1953; equals term start for Spring/Summer terms). The mirrored column in ACADEMIC_TERMS (col_017) is a near-duplicate of the term start date, supporting a second start-date field (start of instruction vs. official start), but the exact distinction is not evidenced.

col_016.name: add_date
col_016.description: Sparse date shortly after term start (e.g. 04-FEB-71 for Spring 1971 starting 03-FEB-71); plausibly an add deadline or registration date. No join evidence available; exact meaning unconfirmed.

col_017.name: drop_or_deadline_date
col_017.description: Sparse date near term end (e.g. 28-MAY-71, 12-AUG-16); plausibly a drop deadline or final day to change status. No join evidence available; exact meaning unconfirmed.

col_020.name: last_updated_date
col_020.description: Constant value 19-DEC-24 on all rows; date the table was last loaded/refreshed.

table.name: ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER
table.purpose: Reference table holding one row per relative academic term designation (current, previous, upcoming) as tracked in the Student Information System (SIS), with each row's term code, description, and key dates. It is referenced by ACADEMIC_TERMS / ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL via the term-type code (C/P/F).

col_001.name: term_parameter_name
col_001.description: Name of the SIS term parameter, indicating the row's relative designation: SIS_CURRENT_TERM, SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM, or SIS_UPCOMING_TERM.

col_002.name: term_type_code
col_002.description: Single-letter code for the relative term designation: C = current, P = previous, F = future/upcoming. Primary key; referenced by ACADEMIC_TERMS and ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.

col_003.name: term_code
col_003.description: SIS term code in YYYYTT format (e.g. 2025FA = Fall 2025, 2024SU = Summer 2024, 2025JA = January/IAP 2025).

col_004.name: term_description
col_004.description: Human-readable term name, e.g. 'Fall Term 2024-2025', 'January Term 2024-2025', 'Summer Term 2024'. Joins to the term description in ACADEMIC_TERMS / ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.

col_005.name: term_start_date
col_005.description: Start date of the term in DD-MON-YY format (e.g. 03-SEP-24 for Fall 2025). Matches a date column in ACADEMIC_TERMS.

col_006.name: term_end_date
col_006.description: End date of the term in DD-MON-YY format (e.g. 20-DEC-24 for Fall 2025, 31-JAN-25 for January Term).

col_007.name: term_official_close_date
col_007.description: A later date in DD-MON-YY format, equal to or after the end date (e.g. 05-JAN-25 for Fall, 02-SEP-24 for Summer). Likely the official close/grade-submission or administrative end of the term; exact semantics not fully confirmed.

col_008.name: is_current_term_flag
col_008.description: Y/N flag; Y only on the SIS_CURRENT_TERM row, suggesting it marks the currently active term. Could alternatively mark some other active/enrollable state, but the pattern strongly supports 'current term' indicator.

table.name: BUILDINGS
table.purpose: MIT campus buildings reference table: one row per building with its code, name, street address, and square footage figures, extracted as of a snapshot date (19-DEC-24). Joins one-to-one to FAC_BUILDING and FCLT_BUILDING on building code.

col_001.name: building_code
col_001.description: Primary key. MIT building number/code (e.g. 'W79', '1', 'E52', 'NE47', 'OC25'). Identical to col_002.

col_002.name: building_code_join
col_002.description: Duplicate of the building code (col_001); used as the join key to FAC_BUILDING and FCLT_BUILDING.

col_003.name: building_name
col_003.description: Official building name (e.g. 'Simmons Hall', 'Ray and Maria Stata Center', 'Henry L Pierce Engineering Laboratory').

col_004.name: street_address
col_004.description: Street address of the building (e.g. '229 VASSAR ST', '50 MEMORIAL DR').

col_006.name: gross_square_feet
col_006.description: Building gross area in square feet (0 to ~466,722; e.g. Simmons Hall 191,241). Larger of the two area figures, so likely gross square footage, though the exact definition is unconfirmed.

col_007.name: net_assignable_square_feet
col_007.description: Second area figure, consistently smaller than col_006 (e.g. Simmons Hall 96,519 vs 191,241 gross); plausibly net/assignable square feet, but the exact definition is unconfirmed.

col_008.name: active_flag
col_008.description: Constant value 1 for all rows; likely an active/valid-record flag, but with no variation its meaning cannot be confirmed.

col_009.name: extract_date
col_009.description: Snapshot/extract date, '19-DEC-24' on every row; indicates when this building list was pulled.

table.name: CIP
table.purpose: NCES Classification of Instructional Programs (CIP) code reference table. Each row is a 6-digit instructional program code with its title, the 2-digit series and 4-digit intermediate category it belongs to, and notes on changes across CIP revisions (1990, 2000, 2010, 2020). Referenced by course-description tables (CIP_WITH_VERSION, SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION) that tag courses/programs with CIP codes.

col_001.name: cip_code
col_001.description: 6-digit NCES CIP program code (e.g. 161201 = Classics). Primary key; referenced by CIP_WITH_VERSION and SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.

col_002.name: cip_title
col_002.description: Official title/description of the 6-digit CIP program (e.g. 'Classics and Classical Languages and Literatures', 'Transportation Law').

col_003.name: cip_series_code
col_003.description: First two digits of the CIP code, identifying the instructional series (e.g. 16 = Foreign Languages, 22 = Legal Professions, 43 = Homeland Security/Law Enforcement). The statistical join to SPACE_USAGE.col_001 is coincidental (room-usage codes share the same numeric range) and not a real relationship.

col_004.name: cip_series_title
col_004.description: Title of the 2-digit CIP series (e.g. 'FOREIGN LANGUAGES AND LITERATURES', 'LEGAL PROFESSIONS AND STUDIES').

col_005.name: cip_intermediate_code
col_005.description: First four digits of the CIP code, the intermediate category between series and full program (e.g. 1612, 2202, 4301).

col_006.name: cip_intermediate_title
col_006.description: Title of the 4-digit intermediate CIP category (e.g. 'Classical and Ancient Near Eastern Languages and Literatures', 'Legal Research and Advanced Professional Studies').

col_007.name: change_notes
col_007.description: Notes describing changes to the code across CIP revisions: new codes ('New in 2020'), no substantive changes, and codes moved from/to other CIP codes (e.g. 'Moved from 51.2931'). Null where no change recorded.

col_008.name: last_updated_date
col_008.description: Date the row was last loaded/updated, as a string in DD-MON-YY form ('17-MAY-23', '11-JUN-14'); the two values correspond to the 2020 and earlier CIP revision loads.

col_009.name: cip_revision_year
col_009.description: CIP revision edition the row's code belongs to: 1990, 2000, 2010, or 2020.

table.name: CIP_WITH_VERSION
table.purpose: Versioned copy of the U.S. NCES Classification of Instructional Programs (CIP). Each row is one CIP instructional program code as defined in a specific CIP edition (1990, 2000, 2010, or 2020), with its code, title, and the higher-level series and intermediate groupings it belongs to. The primary key concatenates the 6-digit CIP code with the edition year, allowing the same code to exist across editions.

col_001.name: cip_code_with_version
col_001.description: Primary key: the 6-digit CIP program code concatenated with the 4-digit CIP edition year (e.g. 1202991990 = CIP 12.0299 in the 1990 edition). Unique across all rows.

col_002.name: cip_version_year
col_002.description: CIP edition/version year: 1990, 2000, 2010, or 2020. Identifies which edition of the NCES CIP taxonomy the row's code and title come from.

col_003.name: cip_code
col_003.description: The 6-digit CIP instructional program code (e.g. 120299). References the CIP table (CIP.col_001). The same code can appear up to 4 times, once per edition.

col_004.name: cip_title
col_004.description: Title/description of the instructional program at the 6-digit level (e.g. 'GAMING AND SPORTS OFFICIATING SERVICES, OTHER', 'Community Awareness'). Wording varies between editions, so the same code can have different titles per version.

col_005.name: cip_series_code
col_005.description: First two digits of the CIP code, identifying the 2-digit series (top-level category, e.g. 12 = Personal and Miscellaneous Services, 43 = Protective Services). The statistical join to SPACE_USAGE is coincidental numeric overlap, not a real relationship.

col_006.name: cip_series_title
col_006.description: Title of the 2-digit CIP series/category the program belongs to (e.g. 'PROTECTIVE SERVICES', 'CITIZENSHIP ACTIVITIES', 'HEALTH PROFESSIONS AND RELATED PROGRAMS').

col_007.name: cip_intermediate_code
col_007.description: First four digits of the CIP code, identifying the intermediate 4-digit grouping within the series (e.g. 1202 = Gaming and Sports Officiating Services, 4301 = Criminal Justice and Corrections).

col_008.name: cip_intermediate_title
col_008.description: Title of the 4-digit intermediate CIP grouping (e.g. 'CRIMINAL JUSTICE AND CORRECTIONS', 'Citizenship Activities'). Case varies across editions (all-caps in older editions, mixed case in newer).

col_009.name: load_date
col_009.description: Date the row was loaded/last updated, in DD-MON-YY Oracle format. Each edition's rows share one load date (e.g. 2020 edition loaded 17-MAY-23), indicating the table was refreshed edition by edition.

table.name: CIS_COURSE_CATALOG
table.purpose: MIT subject (course) catalog snapshot: one row per subject per catalog term, with subject number, title, department, units, grading, level, attributes, prerequisites and description.

col_001.name: offered_fall_flag
col_001.description: Y/N flag; likely whether the subject is offered in the fall term. Ordering of the four Y/N term flags (col_001-col_004) is inferred from typical MIT term distribution (fall ~73%, IAP ~28%, spring ~74%, summer ~24%), so the specific term per flag is tentative.

col_002.name: offered_iap_flag
col_002.description: Y/N flag; likely whether the subject is offered in Independent Activities Period (January). ~28% Y matches IAP share.

col_003.name: offered_spring_flag
col_003.description: Y/N flag; likely whether the subject is offered in the spring term.

col_004.name: offered_summer_flag
col_004.description: Y/N flag; likely whether the subject is offered in the summer term.

col_005.name: instructor_names
col_005.description: Instructor(s) of record for the subject, as display names ('Staff' when unassigned); multiple instructors comma-separated. Null for ~26% of rows (Staff-taught/special subjects).

col_006.name: instructor_names_copy
col_006.description: Duplicate of col_005 (identical distribution and values) - instructor names.

col_008.name: last_updated_date
col_008.description: Date the catalog record was last updated, stored as text in DD-MON-YY Oracle format (e.g. 19-OCT-06).

col_009.name: extract_date
col_009.description: Constant date 19-DEC-24 on all rows - the date the snapshot was extracted/loaded into the warehouse.

col_017.name: catalog_year
col_017.description: Effective catalog year of the subject record (2002-2009).

col_018.name: subject_number
col_018.description: Full MIT subject number, department code + number (e.g. 21F.NIV, 11.951, CMS.THU).

col_019.name: course_number
col_019.description: MIT course/department code (e.g. 15=Management, 12=EAPS, 1=CEE); joins to SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT and STUDENT_DEPARTMENT.

col_020.name: subject_suffix
col_020.description: The part of the subject number after the department code (e.g. NIV, 951, THU, URG).

col_021.name: subject_number_copy
col_021.description: Duplicate of col_018 - full subject number.

col_022.name: subject_number_display
col_022.description: Subject number as displayed in the catalog, including cross-listed forms like '7.3407.349' (en-dash separated) and '2.ThA'; essentially the display version of col_018.

col_024.name: admin_department_code
col_024.description: Administrative department/course code owning the subject (same value set as col_019 but slightly more distinct values); joins to SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.

col_025.name: department_name
col_025.description: Department name corresponding to col_024 (e.g. Management, Electrical Eng & Computer Sci).

col_026.name: term_code
col_026.description: Catalog term code in YYYY{FA|JA|SP|SU} form (e.g. 1997FA, 2007JA); joins to ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.

col_027.name: title_short
col_027.description: Short/abbreviated subject title (e.g. 'Visiting Student Research', 'CMS THESIS').

col_028.name: title_long
col_028.description: Full subject title (e.g. 'Undergraduate Thesis in Comparative Media Studies').

col_030.name: lecture_units
col_030.description: Weekly lecture hours (first component of MIT units, e.g. 3 in '3-?-?'); 0 for most special/thesis subjects. Alternative reading: could be a different component of the units triple, but lecture-hours fits the typical MIT units format.

col_031.name: design_units
col_031.description: Constant 0 across all rows; likely the design-units component of MIT units, unused in this snapshot. Could also be any other always-zero attribute; no join evidence to disambiguate.

col_032.name: lab_units
col_032.description: Weekly lab/field hours (second component of MIT units, 0-18). Alternative reading: could be the design or prep component; ordering within the units triple is inferred.

col_033.name: prep_units
col_033.description: Weekly preparation/homework hours (third component of MIT units, 0-24). Alternative reading: could be another component of the units triple; ordering is inferred.

col_034.name: extra_units
col_034.description: Additional units beyond the standard lecture/lab/prep triple (0 for 99.5% of rows); meaning uncertain. Could be total units or a rarely used extra-units field.

col_035.name: grading_option_code
col_035.description: Grading option code: L = letter graded, P = P/D/F (pass/fail).

col_036.name: grading_option_desc
col_036.description: Description of grading option: 'Letter graded' or 'P/D/F'.

col_037.name: repeat_code
col_037.description: Repeat-for-credit code: R = repeatable, N = not repeatable, J = continuing and repeatable, T = continuing.

col_038.name: repeat_desc
col_038.description: Description of repeat status ('Can be repeated for credit', 'Not repeatable for credit', 'Continuing and Repeatable', 'Continuing').

col_039.name: level_code
col_039.description: Subject level code: U = undergraduate, G = graduate, H = high graduate (graduate-level open to advanced undergraduates).

col_040.name: level_desc
col_040.description: Description of subject level: Undergraduate, Graduate, High Graduate.

col_044.name: hass_attribute_code_cim
col_044.description: CIS/HASS attribute code, only value 'CIM' (Communication Intensive Major); null for ~99% of rows.

col_045.name: hass_attribute_desc_cim
col_045.description: Description of the CIM attribute: 'Communication Intensive Major'.

col_046.name: subject_attribute_code
col_046.description: Subject attribute code: RESH = pre-thesis research subject, NTRN = internship; joins to SUBJECT_ATTRIBUTE.

col_047.name: subject_attribute_desc
col_047.description: Description of col_046: 'Pre-thesis Research Subject' or 'Internship'.

col_048.name: writing_requirement_code
col_048.description: Writing requirement attribute code; only observed value WRT2 (Writing Requirement, Phase II), on 9 rows.

col_049.name: writing_requirement_desc
col_049.description: Description of col_048: 'Writing Requirement, Phase II'.

col_050.name: subject_type_code
col_050.description: Special subject type code: UROP, THG (graduate thesis), THU (undergraduate thesis); null for ~92% of rows.

col_051.name: subject_type_desc
col_051.description: Description of col_050: 'UROP subject', 'Grad Thesis', 'Undergrad Thesis'.

col_052.name: prerequisites
col_052.description: Prerequisite text: subject numbers or 'Permission of instructor'; null when no prerequisites.

col_053.name: description
col_053.description: Free-text catalog description of the subject; null for ~30% of rows.

table.name: CIS_HASS_ATTRIBUTE
table.purpose: Lookup table of MIT HASS (Humanities, Arts, and Social Sciences) requirement attribute codes, mapping short codes (e.g. HA, HS, HD2) to display names and HASS attribute labels, distinguishing the pre-Fall-2010 GIR attribute scheme from the post-2010 HASS attribute scheme. Used to decode HASS/GIR attribute codes on subjects in the course catalog (CIS = Course Information System).

col_001.name: attribute_code
col_001.description: Short internal code for the HASS/GIR attribute (e.g. HA = HASS Arts, HS = HASS Social Sciences, HD2 = HASS-D Category 2, 'HA,HH' = Arts + Humanities combination).

col_002.name: attribute_description
col_002.description: Human-readable description of the attribute, e.g. 'HASS Arts', '1/2 HASS Social Sciences' (half-subject), 'HASS-D, Category 2', 'Arts + Humanities'.

col_003.name: hass_attribute_label
col_003.description: Official HASS attribute label shown on subjects, e.g. 'HASS-A', 'HASS-S', 'HASS-L', 'HASS-D 2', or comma-separated combinations like 'HASS-A, HASS-H'.

col_004.name: attribute_scheme
col_004.description: Flag distinguishing the two requirement schemes: 'H' = HASS attribute (students entering Fall 2010 or later), 'G' = GIR attribute (students entering before Fall 2010). The statistical join to SIS_SUBJECT_CODE is likely coincidental given only two values.

col_005.name: scheme_description
col_005.description: Explanation of the scheme flag: 'HASS_ATTRIBUTE, for students entering in Fall 2010 or later' vs 'GIR_ATTRIBUTE, for students entering prior to Fall 2010'.

col_006.name: icon_filename
col_006.description: Filename of a GIF icon used to display the attribute (e.g. hassS.gif, hassAH.gif, hass2.gif); null for rows without an icon.

col_009.name: effective_date
col_009.description: Date the row was added/last revised (Oracle DD-MON-YY format): 05-MAR-10, 26-APR-10, 22-FEB-12. Alternative reading: an effective-from date for when the attribute code became active; the few distinct values fit either interpretation.

col_010.name: updated_by
col_010.description: Username of the person who last modified the rows; constant 'PETECHOI' across all 17 rows. Could alternatively be the account that loaded/refreshed the table rather than a per-row editor, since the value never varies.

col_011.name: last_updated_date
col_011.description: Date the table was last updated (Oracle DD-MON-YY format); constant '19-DEC-24' on all rows, suggesting a bulk refresh. Alternative reading: a refresh/snapshot timestamp applied uniformly rather than a true per-row last-modified date.

table.name: COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED
table.purpose: MIT course catalog listing of subjects (courses) offered per academic term, with catalog attributes (units, grading, level, HASS/CI attributes, prerequisites, description) and, where present, section-level scheduling details (section code, instructor, meeting time, room). One row per subject offering (or subject-section).

col_001.name: academic_year
col_001.description: Academic year of the term (e.g. 2024 for 2024SP), 2002-2025.

col_002.name: term_code
col_002.description: Term code (YYYY + FA/SP/SU/JA for fall/spring/summer/IAP); references ACADEMIC_TERMS.

col_003.name: subject_number

col_004.name: course_code

col_005.name: subject_suffix

col_007.name: subject_number_display
col_007.description: Subject number as displayed in the catalog, including 'J' joint-subject suffixes (e.g. 2.965J).

col_008.name: offered_flag
col_008.description: Whether the subject is offered in this term (Y=yes, N=not offered; single 'S' likely a special/summer case). Alternative reading: 'S' could mark subjects offered only in a specific session.

col_009.name: admin_department_code
col_009.description: Administrative department code owning the subject; references SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.

col_010.name: department_name
col_010.description: Name of the owning department (e.g. 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci').

col_011.name: catalog_term
col_011.description: Catalog edition term the subject record comes from (e.g. 2016FA); references ACADEMIC_TERMS. Could alternatively be the term the subject was first/last listed.

col_012.name: title_short
col_012.description: Short/abbreviated subject title (e.g. 'Intermed Applied Macroecon').

col_013.name: title
col_013.description: Full subject title (e.g. 'Intermediate Applied Macroeconomics').

col_014.name: is_new_subject_flag
col_014.description: Y/N flag; plausibly marks new subjects, but exact meaning not evidenced.

col_015.name: lecture_hours
col_015.description: Lecture hours per week (first number of MIT X-Y-Z units; e.g. 3-0-9).

col_016.name: lab_or_design_hours
col_016.description: Second component of MIT units (lab/design hours); mostly 0, max 25. Could be lab hours or design units.

col_017.name: prep_hours
col_017.description: Preparation/homework hours per week (third number of MIT X-Y-Z units).

col_018.name: total_units
col_018.description: Total credit units (sum of the three components; typical 12).

col_019.name: extra_units
col_019.description: Additional units, mostly 0 (max 12); possibly units for half-term/partial subjects. Meaning not fully evidenced.

col_020.name: grading_code
col_020.description: Grading option code: L = letter graded, P = P/D/F.

col_022.name: repeat_code

col_023.name: repeat_description
col_023.description: Description of the repeat code (e.g. 'Can be repeated for credit').

col_024.name: level_code
col_024.description: Level code: U = undergraduate, G = graduate, H = high graduate.

col_026.name: hass_exception_note
col_026.description: Note listing departments for which the subject counts as HASS ('H except 18' etc.); almost always null.

col_027.name: hass_rest_attribute_code
col_027.description: HASS/REST attribute code (HE, REST, LAB, CAL2, PHY2...); references SUBJECT_ATTRIBUTE.

col_028.name: hass_rest_attribute_description
col_028.description: Description of the HASS/REST/lab attribute (e.g. 'HASS Elective', 'Institute Lab').

col_029.name: communication_intensive_code
col_029.description: Communication-intensive code: CIM, CIH, CIHW; references SUBJECT_ATTRIBUTE.

col_031.name: special_attribute_code
col_031.description: Special subject attribute code (RESH pre-thesis research, NTRN internship, COOP); references SUBJECT_ATTRIBUTE.

col_032.name: special_attribute_description
col_032.description: Description of the special attribute (e.g. 'Pre-thesis Research Subject').

col_034.name: writing_requirement_description
col_034.description: Writing requirement description (Phase I / Phase II).

col_035.name: subject_type_code
col_035.description: Special subject type code: UROP, INDP (independent study), THG (grad thesis), THU (undergrad thesis).

col_036.name: subject_type_description
col_036.description: Description of the special subject type.

col_037.name: prerequisites
col_037.description: Prerequisite text: subject numbers, GIR requirements (GIR:CAL1), and/or 'permission of instructor'.

col_039.name: joint_subjects
col_039.description: Joint (cross-listed) subject numbers (with 'J' suffix) sharing the same content, e.g. '18.410J', '2.79J, 20.441J, HST.522J'.

col_040.name: meets_with_subjects
col_040.description: List of subjects this subject meets with (e.g. '2.96, 6.930, 10.806, 16.653', '.EPE/.EPW' series).

col_041.name: related_subject_number
col_041.description: A related subject number (e.g. '21G.102' for 21G.152, whose description is under that number). Could be 'same-as/description-under' or equivalent subject; exact semantics uncertain.

col_042.name: alternate_subject_numbers
col_042.description: Alternate/equivalent subject numbers or numbers to see instead (e.g. '18.02, 18.022, 18.02A, CC.1802, ES.182A'). Exact semantics (equivalent vs. replaced-by) uncertain.

col_048.name: instructors_display
col_048.description: Instructor name(s) as displayed in the catalog ('K. Gibbs', 'Staff').

col_049.name: instructors_display_alt
col_049.description: Second copy/variant of the instructor display string; nearly identical to col_048. Alternative reading: could be a differently formatted or source-variant copy of the same instructor list.

col_050.name: change_note
col_050.description: Catalog change note: 'New subject', 'New joint child', '(YYYY: Removed subject)', old/new subject numbers.

col_051.name: last_updated_date
col_051.description: Date the subject record was last updated (DD-MON-YY).

col_052.name: snapshot_date
col_052.description: Warehouse extract/snapshot date; constant '19-DEC-24' across all rows.

col_053.name: description_subject_number
col_053.description: Subject number under which the catalog description is published (e.g. 21G.102 for 21G.152, 'For a description, see 21G.102').

col_054.name: hass_category_code
col_054.description: HASS category code(s): HA (arts), HH (humanities), HS (social sciences), HE (elective); references SUBJECT_ATTRIBUTE.

col_056.name: term_length
col_056.description: Portion of term the subject runs: Full Term, First/Second Half Term, Partial Term.

col_057.name: global_region
col_057.description: Region(s) for global/travel subjects (e.g. 'Global (all regions)', 'Asia'); pipe-delimited; almost always null.

col_058.name: global_country
col_058.description: Country(ies) for global/travel subjects (e.g. 'China', 'France'); pipe-delimited; almost always null.

col_059.name: catalog_url
col_059.description: URL of the MIT online catalog page listing this subject.

col_060.name: section_code
col_060.description: Section/meeting code: 000 (no sections), L01 lecture, R01 recitation, B01 lab, etc.

col_066.name: section_instructor_name
col_066.description: Instructor of the section, 'Last, First' format.

col_067.name: section_instructor_id
col_067.description: Numeric identifier of the section instructor (9-digit ID matching col_066).

col_068.name: meeting_time
col_068.description: Meeting time pattern, e.g. 'TR11-12.30', 'MTRF9', '*TO BE ARRANGED'.

col_002.name: subject_number

col_019.name: grading_code

col_021.name: repeat_code

col_023.name: level_code

col_025.name: hass_exception_note

col_026.name: gir_attribute_code

col_027.name: gir_attribute_description

col_036.name: prerequisites_text

col_047.name: instructors_display

col_050.name: last_updated_date

table.name: FAC_BUILDING
table.purpose: MIT Facilities building inventory: one row per campus building/structure, with building number, names, floor areas, campus sector, ownership, use classification, and location coordinates.

col_001.name: acquisition_date
col_001.description: Date the building was acquired or added to the space inventory (MM/DD/YYYY); null for most rows.

col_002.name: disposition_date
col_002.description: Date the building was disposed of, demolished, or removed from inventory (MM/DD/YYYY); null for active buildings. Could alternatively be a record-effective date, but the many 12/31/1916 and future 2024-2026 values suggest disposal/lease-end dates.

col_003.name: extract_date
col_003.description: Date the data was extracted/loaded; constant '19-DEC-24' across all rows.

col_004.name: room_count
col_004.description: Count of rooms in the building (0 to 1424).

col_005.name: building_number
col_005.description: MIT building number/code (e.g. '42', 'E66', 'W85A', 'OC25'); unique per row, referenced by floor, room, and address tables.

col_006.name: building_number_alt
col_006.description: Duplicate of the building number (identical values to col_005); likely a second copy of the key.

col_007.name: parent_building_number
col_007.description: Building number of a parent/consolidated building this row belongs to (e.g. W61 for MacGregor House entries, W85ABC for Westgate); null for standalone buildings.

col_008.name: group_name_upper

col_009.name: group_name_mixed

col_010.name: building_name

col_011.name: gross_area_sqft

col_012.name: assignable_area_sqft

col_013.name: non_assignable_area_sqft

col_014.name: site_code

col_015.name: campus_sector

col_018.name: major_use_category

col_019.name: ownership

table.name: FAC_FLOOR
table.purpose: Facilities floor-level space inventory: one row per building floor (or floor group), with floor areas (net, assignable, non-assignable) and floor number attributes, as of an extract date. Complements FCLT_FLOOR (one-to-one on the floor key).

col_001.name: extract_date
col_001.description: Snapshot/extract date of the data, constant '19-DEC-24' across all rows.

col_002.name: building_number
col_002.description: Building number/code (e.g. E37, W84, 54, OC25), referencing FAC_BUILDING / FCLT_BUILDING.

col_003.name: floor_number
col_003.description: Floor number within the building (0-30, mostly 0-5); some non-numeric values like 'D6' suggest it can hold sub-level or coded floor designations.

col_004.name: floor_key
col_004.description: Composite floor identifier 'building-floor' (e.g. E19-2, W85-14); unique per row, one-to-one with FCLT_FLOOR and referenced by room tables (FAC_ROOMS, FCLT_ROOMS).

col_005.name: net_area_sqft
col_005.description: Total/net floor area in square feet (0 to ~120,074; median ~10,439). Largest of the three area columns, so likely total floor area. Alternative reading: it could be strictly 'net' area distinct from a gross total not present here.

col_006.name: assignable_area_sqft
col_006.description: Assignable (occupiable program) area in square feet; 0 for 117 rows (floors with no assignable space). Alternative reading: could be 'assigned' area (area actually assigned to departments) rather than assignable capacity.

col_007.name: non_assignable_area_sqft
col_007.description: Non-assignable area (circulation, mechanical, etc.) in square feet; smallest of the three, 0 for 57 rows. Alternative reading: could be a residual (net minus assignable) rather than an independently measured value.

col_008.name: floor_number_code
col_008.description: Floor number as stored in the source system, mostly matching col_003 but including negative values (-2, -3) for basement levels; likely the canonical floor code. Alternative reading: it may be a separate encoding (e.g. sort order) rather than a duplicate of the floor number.

col_010.name: floor_group_note
col_010.description: Rare (98.6% null) text listing floor keys (e.g. 'W61E.3 W61F.3 ...'), apparently grouping/merging several floors of building W61 into one row; meaning beyond that unresolved.

table.name: FAC_MAJOR_USE
table.purpose: Lookup table of facility space major-use categories (e.g., classrooms, laboratories, circulation, residential), used to classify rooms in facility/room tables such as FAC_ROOMS, FCLT_ROOMS and their history tables. Each row is one major-use category with a numeric key, an 8-character code, and a full description label. Likely a snapshot of FCLT_MAJOR_USE as of 19-DEC-24 (col_005).

col_001.name: major_use_id
col_001.description: Primary key; numeric identifier (101-114) of the major-use category. Referenced by room tables (FAC_ROOMS, FCLT_ROOMS, FCLT_ROOMS_HIST) and FCLT_MAJOR_USE_HIST.

col_002.name: major_use_code
col_002.description: Short 8-character code for the major-use category (e.g., CIRCULAT, CLASSRMS, RESIDENT, UNCLASS). Referenced by room tables as the category code.

col_003.name: major_use_description
col_003.description: Full description/label of the major-use category (e.g., CIRCULATION AREA, CLASSROOMS, LABORATORIES, UNCLASSIFIED).

col_004.name: assignable_flag
col_004.description: Boolean-like flag (0/1) indicating whether the category is assignable space (1 for 11 categories such as classrooms, laboratories, offices; 0 for 3 such as circulation, mechanical, building service). Exact semantics (e.g., assignable vs. reportable) are tentative.

col_005.name: snapshot_date
col_005.description: Date value '19-DEC-24' on every row; likely the extraction/snapshot date of this table, matching the snapshot dates in FAC_ROOMS and FCLT_ROOMS. Could also be a last-update date; exact meaning is tentative.

table.name: FAC_ORGANIZATION
table.purpose: Current reference table of MIT facilities/space organizational units (DLCs - departments, labs and centers) that occupy or are responsible for space. One row per organization code, with its code, name, hierarchy (parent unit, top-level executive area), SAP cost center, HR org unit, and department hierarchy code. Referenced by room tables (FAC_ROOMS, FCLT_ROOMS) and the FCLT_ORGANIZATION history table. Snapshot dated 19-DEC-24 (col_015).

col_001.name: organization_number
col_001.description: Primary key: numeric organization/DLC identifier (101-288). Referenced by room tables (FAC_ROOMS.col_014, FCLT_ROOMS) and FCLT_ORGANIZATION history as the owning organization of a room.

col_002.name: organization_number_duplicate
col_002.description: Duplicate of col_001 (identical values, one-to-one). Same organization number; also joins one-to-one to SPACE_UNIT.col_001 and FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY.col_001.

col_003.name: organization_code
col_003.description: Short alphanumeric organization code (e.g. LINCLB, AERO, MECH, PHYSIC, ALL). Referenced by room tables as the room's organization code.

col_004.name: organization_name
col_004.description: Full name of the organization (e.g. 'LINCOLN LAB', 'MCGOVERN INSTITUTE', 'HISTORY').

col_005.name: parent_organization_number
col_005.description: Number of the parent organization in the reporting hierarchy (values are themselves organization numbers, e.g. 152, 163, 243, 266). Null for top-level units.

col_006.name: parent_organization_code
col_006.description: Short code of the parent organization (e.g. OVC, EXECVP, S ENG, VP-RES, S H&SS), matching col_005.

col_007.name: top_level_organization_number
col_007.description: Number of the top-level (root) organization in the hierarchy (e.g. 230 = Provost, 129 = Chancellor, 163 = Executive VP).

col_008.name: top_level_organization_code
col_008.description: Short code of the top-level executive area (PROVST, CHNCLR, EXECVP, PRES, VP-SCP, ZORG, ALL), matching col_007.

col_009.name: hierarchy_level
col_009.description: Depth of the organization in the hierarchy tree (1-6); most units are at level 5. Plausible alternative: an org-type classification code, but level fits the parent/top-level structure.

col_010.name: cost_center
col_010.description: SAP cost center number (e.g. 310000, 401800) for the organization; joins to SPACE_UNIT cost center columns.

col_011.name: fund_center_or_sap_object_code
col_011.description: 9-digit SAP code (100000000-101120010), likely a fund center / controlling-area object code. Exact SAP meaning unresolved.

col_012.name: is_active
col_012.description: Boolean flag, 1 for active organizations (166 of 169), 0 for inactive.

col_014.name: long_description
col_014.description: Longer descriptive name of the organization (e.g. 'Dept of Earth, Atmospheric, & Planetary Sciences'), populated for ~39% of rows.

col_015.name: snapshot_date
col_015.description: Date the snapshot was taken/loaded, '19-DEC-24' on every row.

col_016.name: dept_hierarchy_code
col_016.description: Department hierarchy code prefixed with 'D_' (e.g. D_LINCOLN, D_MECHE, D_RAS); joins to MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.

col_017.name: cost_center_alt
col_017.description: Cost center number, nearly identical to col_010 (same value range and top values); likely a second/alternate cost center field. Joins to SPACE_UNIT's org-number columns (col_002/col_003), so it may in fact be the organization number as keyed in the space system rather than a pure SAP cost center; the minor differences vs col_010 remain unresolved.

col_018.name: hr_org_unit_id
col_018.description: HR organizational unit key (10000265-10005759); joins to HR_ORG_UNIT.col_002.

col_019.name: hr_org_unit_name
col_019.description: Name of the HR organizational unit corresponding to col_018 (e.g. 'Lincoln Laboratory', 'Research Administration Services').

table.name: FAC_ROOMS

col_002.name: room_code

col_004.name: floor_number

col_005.name: floor_code
col_005.description: Floor identifier combining building and floor, e.g. '18-1', 'W34-1'; references FAC_FLOOR / FCLT_FLOOR.

col_006.name: room_number
col_006.description: Room number within the floor/building, e.g. '158', '110', '282B'.

col_007.name: room_key
col_007.description: Fully qualified room key building-floor-room, e.g. '18-1-158', 'W34-1-110'.

col_008.name: major_use_code

col_009.name: major_use_abbrev

col_010.name: room_use_code

col_015.name: organization_abbrev

col_018.name: room_area_sqft
col_018.description: Room area, most likely in square feet (values 0 to ~24,000, median ~122).

col_021.name: room_condition_or_status
col_021.description: Small integer 0-3 assigned per room. Could be a condition/quality rating or occupancy status code; no lookup evidence available.

table.name: FCLT_BUILDING

col_001.name: building_number
col_001.description: Primary key: MIT building number/code (e.g. '42', 'E66', 'W85A', 'OC19Q'). Referenced by floor, room, address, and history tables.

col_002.name: building_number_alt
col_002.description: Duplicate of col_001 (identical values in all rows); a second copy of the building number, likely the source-system key.

col_003.name: group_building_number

col_006.name: building_name

col_010.name: site_code

col_011.name: campus_sector

col_014.name: major_use_category

col_015.name: ownership_status
col_015.description: OWNED vs LEASED.

col_018.name: acreage

col_019.name: state_plane_x

col_020.description: Duplicate of col_019 (identical values).

col_021.name: latitude

col_022.name: longitude

col_023.name: projected_x
col_023.description: X coordinate in a local/projected grid (values ~657k-796k, likely MIT campus grid or MA State Plane feet); exact projection unresolved.

col_024.name: projected_y

col_025.name: building_number_padded
col_025.description: Building number again, zero-padded/normalized ('01', '02', ... 'E66'); joins to history tables and FAC_BUILDING.

col_026.name: building_dedication_names
col_026.description: Person(s) the building is named for (e.g. 'CHARLES HAYDEN', 'RALPH LANDAU'); '-' when not named for a person.

col_027.name: building_name_upper
col_027.description: Uppercase building name/address label (e.g. 'COGENERATION PLANT', '1 MEMORIAL DRIVE').

col_030.name: occupancy_or_completion_date

col_031.name: extract_date

col_032.name: room_count
col_032.description: Number of rooms in the building (0 to 1,424); likely a count of rooms from the FCLT_ROOMS table.

col_034.name: room_count
col_034.description: Count of rooms in the building (0-1410); plausible given FAC_ROOMS table exists, but could be another count.

table.name: FCLT_BUILDING_HIST_1
table.purpose: Monthly historical snapshot of MIT facilities building inventory data (FCLT = facilities). Each row is one building (or building wing/section) as of one month (2015-05 through 2019-06), tracking building attributes, areas, location, and lifecycle dates over time. Companion to FCLT_BUILDING (current) and FCLT_BUILDING_HIST (same data, this appears to be a copy/variant).

col_001.name: building_month_key
col_001.description: Primary key: building code + '-' + snapshot month (YYYYMM), e.g. 'W91-201508'. Uniquely identifies one building's record in one monthly snapshot.

col_002.name: snapshot_month
col_002.description: Snapshot month as YYYYMM integer (201505-201906); joins to TIME_MONTH. Each month has ~244 buildings.

col_003.name: building_code
col_003.description: MIT building number/code (e.g. 'W91', '32P', 'N57', 'OC19G'), including wing suffixes; references FCLT_BUILDING.

col_004.name: building_code_2
col_004.description: Duplicate of col_003 (building code); identical values and join profile.

col_005.name: parent_building_code
col_005.description: Code of the parent/main building when the row is a wing or sub-building (e.g. 'W61' for MacGregor wing W61H); null for standalone buildings. References FAC_BUILDING/FCLT_BUILDING.

col_006.name: parent_building_name
col_006.description: Uppercase name of the parent building (e.g. 'MACGREGOR HOUSE'); null when no parent.

col_007.name: parent_building_name_mixed_case
col_007.description: Mixed-case name of the parent building (e.g. 'Frank S MacGregor House'); null when no parent.

col_008.name: building_name
col_008.description: Name of the building/wing, e.g. 'Ray and Maria Stata Center', 'Building 24', 'J B Carr Indoor Tennis Facility (Office)'.

col_009.name: gross_area_sqft
col_009.description: Gross floor area in square feet (0 to ~464,005; e.g. Stata garage 239,353).

col_010.name: assignable_area_sqft
col_010.description: Assignable (net usable) area in square feet; always <= gross area, often 0 for garages/service buildings.

col_011.name: non_assignable_area_sqft
col_011.description: Non-assignable area (circulation, mechanical, etc.) in square feet; gross minus assignable in samples.

col_012.name: site_code
col_012.description: Campus/site code: MIT (main campus), BATES (Bates Linear Accelerator), LINC (Lincoln Laboratory), HAY (Haystack Observatory), BOS (Boston campus), END (Endicott House).

col_013.name: campus_sector
col_013.description: Campus sector/region: WEST, MAIN GROUP, OFFCAMPUS, EAST, NORTHWEST, NORTHEAST, etc. (values like 'WESTWEST' suggest concatenation artifacts).

col_014.name: building_condition_code
col_014.description: Numeric code 0-3, likely a building condition rating (0-3); exact code meanings not evidenced.

col_015.name: building_condition_code_2
col_015.description: Duplicate of col_014 (same 0-3 distribution); likely condition rating stored as text.

col_016.name: use_category
col_016.description: Primary use category: ACADEMIC, RESIDENT (residential), SERVICE.

col_017.name: ownership_status
col_017.description: OWNED vs LEASED.

col_018.name: building_type_code
col_018.description: Building type code: AER (academic/research?), DHOA (dormitory/house?), GAR (garage), STAC (stacks?), OTH (other), (NULL) placeholder. Exact meanings not evidenced.

col_019.name: use_detail_code
col_019.description: Detailed use code composed of segments (UGB, UGR2, UGBA3, UGA1A3BH...), likely room-use classification hierarchy; exact meanings unresolved.

col_020.name: num_floors_or_height
col_020.description: Numeric 0-275 with decimals; could be height (feet) or floor count. Values like 275, 240.4 suggest feet; 0 common. Units not evidenced.

col_021.name: state_plane_x
col_021.description: State Plane coordinate (easting, Massachusetts Mainland zone, ~1.34M-1.9M ft); identical to col_022. Alternative reading: a local planar easting in a different grid.

col_022.name: state_plane_x_2
col_022.description: Duplicate of col_021; State Plane easting coordinate.

col_023.name: latitude
col_023.description: Latitude in decimal degrees (~42.25-42.62, centered on Cambridge MA).

col_024.name: longitude
col_024.description: Longitude in decimal degrees (~-71.49 to -70.98, centered on Cambridge MA).

col_025.name: map_x_coordinate
col_025.description: X coordinate in a local/planar grid (~764,000-796,000; outlier 922.337 likely a placeholder). Possibly NAD83 Massachusetts State Plane feet.

col_026.name: map_y_coordinate
col_026.description: Y coordinate in a local/planar grid (~2.95M-3.05M; outlier 922.337 placeholder). Pairs with col_025.

col_027.name: building_code_3
col_027.description: Building code again (matches col_003/col_004); references FAC_BUILDING/FCLT_BUILDING.

col_028.name: named_after_donor
col_028.description: Person(s) the building is named for (e.g. 'CHARLES HAYDEN', 'R. C. MACLAURIN', 'RAY STATA '57'); '-' when unnamed.

col_029.name: building_name_upper
col_029.description: Building name in uppercase (e.g. 'STATA CENTER GARAGE', 'MACGREGOR HOUSE (H)'); slightly different variants from col_008.

col_030.name: acquired_date
col_030.description: Date the building was acquired/built (DD-MON-YY), e.g. '31-DEC-47', '02-JUN-03'; null for many. Could be acquisition date or construction date; the two readings are not distinguishable from the evidence.

col_033.name: record_effective_date
col_033.description: Date matching the snapshot month (first/last day of the snapshot month); the as-of date of this history record.

col_034.name: room_count
col_034.description: Count of rooms in the building (0 to 1410); plausibly joins conceptually to FCLT_ROOMS counts. Could also be another count metric.

table.name: FCLT_FLOOR
table.purpose: Facilities floor-level space inventory: one row per floor of each building, with floor identifier, floor number, and square-footage breakdowns (total, assignable, non-assignable). Snapshot dated 19-DEC-24; referenced by room tables (FCLT_ROOMS, FAC_ROOMS) and history tables (FCLT_FLOOR_HIST).

col_001.name: floor_key
col_001.description: Primary key: building number + floor number (e.g. 'E19-2' = building E19, floor 2). Referenced by room and floor-history tables.

col_002.name: building_number
col_002.description: Building identifier (MIT building number such as E37, W84, 54, OC19Q). Foreign key to FCLT_BUILDING / FAC_BUILDING.

col_003.name: floor_number
col_003.description: Floor number within the building (0-30; 0 = ground floor). Mostly numeric but contains values like 'D6', so stored as text.

col_004.name: total_floor_area_sqft
col_004.description: Total floor area in square feet (0 to ~120,074; mean ~13,371). Largest of the three area columns.

col_005.name: assignable_area_sqft
col_005.description: Assignable (room/occupiable) area in square feet; always <= total area. 117 floors have 0.

col_006.name: non_assignable_area_sqft
col_006.description: Non-assignable area (circulation, mechanical, etc.) in square feet; roughly total minus assignable. Alternative reading: it could be a directly measured non-assignable figure rather than a computed remainder, since it does not always equal total minus assignable exactly.

col_007.name: floor_number_current
col_007.description: Floor number, apparently a current/alternate version of col_003 (nearly identical distribution, includes negatives like -2, -3 for basements). Exact difference from col_003 unresolved; no join evidence distinguishes it.

col_008.name: floor_number_original
col_008.description: Another floor-number variant with 11% nulls and values down to -3; likely the original/historical floor number. Exact distinction from col_003/col_007 unresolved; no join evidence distinguishes it.

col_009.name: floor_alias_list
col_009.description: Rarely populated (1.4%) list of alternate floor keys, e.g. 'W61E.3 W61F.3 ...' for mezzanine/subdivided floors of building W61. The '.n' suffix likely denotes sub-floors/mezzanines within a floor group, but this remains unconfirmed.

col_011.name: snapshot_date
col_011.description: Extract/snapshot date of the data, constant '19-DEC-24' across all rows.

table.name: FCLT_FLOOR_HIST
table.purpose: Monthly history snapshot of floor-level facility (space) records: one row per building-floor per month, tracking floor number, floor area (sq ft), assigned/room areas, and room counts over time. The FCLT_ prefix suggests a facilities/floor data mart; this is the history version of FCLT_FLOOR.

col_001.name: floor_history_key
col_001.description: Primary key: composite string of building-floor code + month (e.g. 'W61A-2-201505'), unique per row.

col_002.name: month_key
col_002.description: Snapshot month in YYYYMM form (201505-201602); references TIME_MONTH.

col_003.name: floor_key
col_003.description: Building-floor code (building number + floor, e.g. 'W61A-2'); references FAC_FLOOR / FCLT_FLOOR.

col_004.name: building_number
col_004.description: MIT building number/code (e.g. 'W61A', 'E55', '54'); references FAC_BUILDING / FCLT_BUILDING.

col_005.name: floor_number
col_005.description: Floor number within the building (0-30, with some non-numeric values like 'D6' and '00' suggesting basement/sub-level codes).

col_006.name: floor_area_sqft
col_006.description: Total floor area, presumably in square feet (0 - ~120,074).

col_007.name: assigned_area_sqft
col_007.description: Assigned/program area of the floor in square feet; always <= col_006 in samples, 0 for unassigned floors. Could also be net assignable area.

col_008.name: room_area_sqft
col_008.description: Area contained in rooms on the floor (sq ft); smaller than assigned area, 0 when no rooms. Could be a different area category (e.g. office/lab area).

col_011.name: merged_floor_codes
col_011.description: Rarely populated (1.3%); space-separated list of floor codes (e.g. 'W61E.3 W61F.3 ...'), suggesting floors merged/combined into this record, mostly for W61 sub-buildings.

col_013.name: snapshot_date
col_013.description: First day of a month (Oracle DD-MON-YY format), lagging col_002 by roughly one month in samples (e.g. month 201505 -> 01-DEC-14 is inconsistent); likely the effective or load date of the record. Exact relationship to col_002 unresolved.

col_001.name: major_use_code
col_001.description: Numeric major-use category code (101-114) identifying one row of this lookup table; referenced by room inventory tables (FAC_ROOMS, FCLT_ROOMS and their history tables) and FCLT_MAJOR_USE_HIST to classify a room's major space use (e.g. 102 = CIRCULATION AREA, 107 = MECHANICAL AREA, 108 = OFFICES).

col_002.name: major_use_abbreviation
col_002.description: Short 8-character code/abbreviation of the major-use category (e.g. CIRCULAT, CLASSRMS, RESIDENT, UNCLASS, MECHANIC), referenced by room tables and the history table as the category abbreviation.

col_003.name: major_use_description
col_003.description: Full description/label of the major-use category (e.g. CIRCULATION AREA, CLASSROOMS, LABORATORIES, UNCLASSIFIED), matching the description column in FAC_MAJOR_USE and FCLT_MAJOR_USE_HIST.

table.name: FCLT_MAJOR_USE_HIST
table.purpose: Monthly history of facility space major-use categories: one row per major-use code per month, tracking each use category's active/inactive status over time (a history companion to FCLT_MAJOR_USE).

col_001.name: major_use_month_key
col_001.description: Primary key: composite of major-use code and month (e.g. '114-202211' = use code 114, month 202211).

col_002.name: month
col_002.description: Month identifier in YYYYMM form (201505-202505); joins to TIME_MONTH.

col_003.name: major_use_code
col_003.description: Major-use category code (101-114), referencing FCLT_MAJOR_USE / FAC_MAJOR_USE (e.g. 102 = CIRCULATION AREA, 107 = MECHANICAL AREA).

col_004.name: major_use_abbreviation
col_004.description: Short code/abbreviation of the major-use category (e.g. CIRCULAT, MECHANIC, UNCLASS), matching the lookup table's abbreviation column.

col_005.name: major_use_description
col_005.description: Full description of the major-use category (e.g. CIRCULATION AREA, MECHANICAL AREA, ZUSE ICR ONLY).

col_006.name: active_flag
col_006.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the major-use category was active in that month (1 = active, 0 = inactive). Alternative reading: it could mark whether the category's definition/record was current as of that month rather than an operational active status; the evidence does not distinguish these.

col_007.name: effective_date
col_007.description: Effective date of the row's status, stored as DD-MON-YY (e.g. 01-JUN-22); likely the date the record became effective for that month. Alternative reading: it could be the date the row was last updated or the snapshot date of the history entry; the evidence does not distinguish these.

table.name: FCLT_ORGANIZATION
table.purpose: Facilities (space management) organization dimension: one row per MIT DLC (department, lab, or center) that can own or occupy space, with its codes, hierarchy (parent/school/top-level), and cross-references to space, HR, and department-hierarchy systems. It is the current version of FAC_ORGANIZATION (with an _HIST history table).

col_001.name: organization_id
col_001.description: Primary key: numeric ID (101-288) of the facilities organization (DLC).

col_002.name: org_number
col_002.description: Same organization number as col_001 (duplicate of the key); also used as a foreign key to FAC_ORGANIZATION and FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY.

col_003.name: org_code
col_003.description: Short alphanumeric code of the organization (e.g. AERO, MECH, PHYSIC, DOFADM), matching FAC_ORGANIZATION's code column.

col_004.name: org_name
col_004.description: Full name of the organization (e.g. 'DP OF FACIL ADM', 'MCGOVERN INSTITUTE', 'HISTORY').

col_005.name: parent_org_id
col_005.description: ID of the parent organization in the same hierarchy (e.g. 163 EXECVP, 152 OVC, 243 S ENG); null for a few top-level rows.

col_006.name: parent_org_code
col_006.description: Short code of the parent organization (EXECVP, OVC, S ENG, VP-RES, S H&SS).

col_007.name: top_level_org_id
col_007.description: ID of the top-level (root) organization of the hierarchy branch (230 PROVST for 89 rows, 129 CHNCLR, 163 EXECVP).

col_008.name: top_level_org_code
col_008.description: Code of the top-level organization (PROVST, CHNCLR, EXECVP, ZORG, OTHMIT, PRES, etc.).

col_009.name: hierarchy_level
col_009.description: Depth level in the organization hierarchy, 1 (top) to 6; most rows are level 4-5.

col_010.name: space_unit_number
col_010.description: Space unit / cost-center-style number (e.g. 591040, 401800) linking the org to SPACE_UNIT for space allocation.

col_011.name: cost_center_or_sap_number
col_011.description: Large numeric identifier, mostly 101xxxxxx values, likely a SAP/cost-center or DLC key number; exact system unresolved. No joins provide further evidence.

col_012.name: is_active
col_012.description: Boolean flag, 1 = active organization (175 rows), 0 = inactive (5 rows).

col_013.name: subject_code
col_013.description: MIT course subject code (e.g. 21L Literature, STS) for academic departments; null for non-academic orgs.

col_014.name: long_name
col_014.description: Longer descriptive name of the org (e.g. 'Dept of Earth, Atmospheric, & Planetary Sciences'); populated mainly for academic units.

col_015.name: snapshot_date
col_015.description: Date the record was extracted/last updated; constant '19-DEC-24' across all rows.

col_016.name: dept_dcode
col_016.description: Department hierarchy code (D_ prefix, e.g. D_FACILITIES, D_LIT) joining to MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY / MASTER_DEPT_DCODE_PARENT.

col_017.name: dept_dcode_name
col_017.description: Name corresponding to the D-code (e.g. 'Department of Facilities', 'Institute Professors').

col_018.name: space_unit_number_alt
col_018.description: Nearly identical to col_010 (space unit number) with slightly more nulls; joins to SPACE_UNIT's org number, so it identifies the same space-occupying unit. Likely a second/current space unit assignment, but the reason for the duplicate column is unclear.

col_019.name: hr_org_unit_id
col_019.description: HR organization unit number (1000xxxx) joining to HR_ORG_UNIT / HR_ORG_UNIT_NEW.

col_020.name: hr_org_unit_name
col_020.description: Name of the HR organization unit (e.g. 'Literature Section', 'Museum').

table.name: FCLT_ORGANIZATION_HIST
table.purpose: Monthly history/snapshot table of MIT facility-related organizations (DLCs - departments, labs and centers). Each row is one organization as of one month, tracking its code, name, hierarchy (parent, top-level, level), and links to space, HR, and department-hierarchy systems over time (roughly 2015-2022).

col_001.name: org_month_key
col_001.description: Primary key: concatenation of organization code and snapshot month (e.g. '150-202010' = org 150, month 202010).

col_002.name: snapshot_month
col_002.description: Snapshot month in YYYYMM format (201505-202206); joins to TIME_MONTH.

col_003.name: org_code
col_003.description: Facilities organization code (DLC number, 101-277); references FAC_ORGANIZATION / FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY.

col_004.name: org_code_2
col_004.description: Duplicate of col_003 (organization code); identical distribution and joins.

col_005.name: org_abbreviation
col_005.description: Short abbreviation of the organization (e.g. DOFADM, RESDOF, AERO, MECH); references FAC_ORGANIZATION.

col_006.name: org_name
col_006.description: Abbreviated organization name (e.g. 'DP OF FACIL ADM', 'MCGOVERN INSTITUTE', 'HISTORY').

col_007.name: parent_org_code
col_007.description: Code of the parent organization in the facilities hierarchy (e.g. 230 = Provost, 163 = Executive VP); null when no parent.

col_008.name: parent_org_abbreviation
col_008.description: Abbreviation of the parent organization (S ENG, EXECVP, DUE, VP-RES, S H&SS).

col_009.name: top_level_code
col_009.description: Top-level (root) of the hierarchy; values are a mix of numeric org codes (230, 129, 163) and role labels (PROVST, CHNCLR, PRES, EXECVP, ALL). No join evidence available to disambiguate whether the numeric values are FAC_ORGANIZATION org codes or a separate coding scheme.

col_010.name: top_level_code_2
col_010.description: Alternate top-level attribution: mostly role labels (PROVST, CHNCLR, EXECVP, ZORG, OTHMIT) but sometimes numeric codes (402100, 061500) or 'ALL'. Likely a second hierarchy rollup; no join evidence to resolve exact semantics.

col_011.name: hierarchy_level
col_011.description: Depth of the organization in the hierarchy, 1 (top) to 6.

col_012.name: space_unit_code
col_012.description: Space accounting unit code (e.g. 591040, 409000); references SPACE_UNIT.

col_013.name: cost_object_number
col_013.description: 9-digit number starting with 101 (e.g. 101030621), likely a SAP cost center / DLC key for the organization. Plausible but not confirmed by any join.

col_014.name: is_active
col_014.description: Boolean flag, 1 = active/valid record (97.5%), 0 = inactive. Could alternatively mark whether the organization itself was active in that month; no join evidence to distinguish.

col_016.name: alt_long_name
col_016.description: Sparse (98% null) full organization name (e.g. 'Institute For Medical Engineering & Science'); pairs with col_015 for a small set of newer/renamed organizations. No join evidence to confirm the pairing or source.

col_017.name: effective_date
col_017.description: Effective date of the snapshot, formatted DD-MON-YY, always the 1st of the month matching col_002.

col_018.name: dept_dcode
col_018.description: Department hierarchy code (D_ prefix, e.g. D_FACILITIES, D_MECHE); references MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY / MASTER_DEPT_DCODE_PARENT.

col_019.name: dept_name
col_019.description: Full department name corresponding to col_018 (e.g. 'Department of Facilities', 'Mechanical Engineering').

col_020.name: space_unit_code_2
col_020.description: Space unit code, essentially a duplicate of col_012 (slightly different null rate); references SPACE_UNIT.

col_021.name: hr_org_unit_id
col_021.description: HR organizational unit number (10000xxx); references HR_ORG_UNIT / HR_ORG_UNIT_NEW.

col_022.name: hr_org_unit_name
col_022.description: Name of the HR organizational unit (e.g. 'Dining', 'School of Engineering', 'Office of the Provost').

table.name: FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY
table.purpose: Crosswalk between a numeric facility-organization key (col_001) and MIT DLC (department, lab, or center) codes (col_002). It is the key/lookup table that FAC_ORGANIZATION, FCLT_ORGANIZATION, FCLT_ROOMS and their history tables reference for space-occupant organizations.

col_001.name: org_key
col_001.description: Numeric organization key (DLC identifier) used in the facilities space tables; primary key of this table, range 101-288. Referenced by FAC_ORGANIZATION, FCLT_ORGANIZATION, FCLT_ROOMS (and _HIST variants) as the owning/occupying organization.

col_002.name: dlc_code
col_002.description: MIT DLC (department/lab/center) code prefixed with 'D_' (e.g. D_MECHE, D_IS&T, D_RESDEV, D_PROVOST). Joins to MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY and MASTER_DEPT_DCODE_PARENT. ~5% null, likely for organizations lacking a DLC code.

table.name: FCLT_ROOMS
table.purpose: Facilities room inventory: one row per room (or room sub-part) in MIT buildings, with building/floor/room codes, space use classification, owning organization, and room area in square feet. Snapshot dated 19-DEC-24 (col_026). Complements FAC_ROOMS and FCLT_ROOMS_HIST.

col_001.name: room_id
col_001.description: Primary key: full room identifier in MIT building-room format, e.g. 'E37-799A' = building E37, room 799A.

col_002.name: room_id_duplicate
col_002.description: Exact duplicate of col_001 (same values, same counts); likely a second copy of the room identifier.

col_003.name: building_number
col_003.description: Building number/code (e.g. 'E37', '46', 'W85A'); references FCLT_BUILDING / FAC_BUILDING.

col_004.name: floor_number
col_004.description: Floor number within the building (0-30, plus basement codes like 'D6'); part of the room key.

col_005.name: building_floor_code
col_005.description: Composite building-floor code (e.g. 'E37-7'); references FCLT_FLOOR / FAC_FLOOR.

col_006.name: room_number
col_006.description: Room number/suffix within the floor (e.g. '799A', '395C').

col_007.name: full_room_code
col_007.description: Fully qualified room code combining building, floor and room number: 'E37-7-799A'.

col_008.name: major_use_code
col_008.description: Space major-use code (101-113) referencing FAC/FCLT_MAJOR_USE; e.g. 108=OFFICES, 102=CIRCULATION AREA, 109=RESIDENTIAL, 107=MECHANICAL AREA.

col_009.name: major_use_abbrev
col_009.description: 8-character abbreviation of the major use category (OFFICES, CIRCULAT, RESIDENT, MECHANIC, LABS, ...); matches FAC_MAJOR_USE.col_002.

col_010.name: organization_number
col_010.description: Numeric organization/DLC key (range 101-204 within the 101-288 org key range) referencing FAC_ORGANIZATION.col_001 / FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY.col_001. Given col_014 already carries the owning organization, this may be a second organization attribute (e.g. occupant vs. owner) or a duplicate copy of the organization number; the exact role relative to col_014 is uncertain.

col_014.name: organization_code
col_014.description: Owning/assigned DLC (department, lab, center) organization code (e.g. 149=DOF, 236=RESIDE, 245=S MGMT); references FAC_ORGANIZATION / FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY.

col_015.name: organization_abbrev
col_015.description: 6-character abbreviation of the owning organization (DOF, RESIDE, S MGMT, AERO, MECH, ...); matches FAC_ORGANIZATION.col_003.

col_018.name: room_area_sqft
col_018.description: Room area, almost certainly in square feet (median ~140, max 108,475).

col_019.name: room_name
col_019.description: Named-room designation for special rooms (e.g. 'HUNTINGTON HALL', 'KRESGE LOBBY'); populated for <0.3% of rooms.

col_020.name: named_room_code
col_020.description: 5-digit code (93300-93800) appearing only for named rooms; likely a named-space/room-name code. Meaning of individual values unresolved.

col_026.name: snapshot_date
col_026.description: Extract/snapshot date of this room inventory; constant '19-DEC-24' across all rows.

table.name: FCLT_ROOMS_HIST
table.purpose: Historical snapshot (as of 2015-05 / loaded 01-DEC-14) of MIT facilities room inventory: one row per room, with building, floor, room number, space use category, owning organization, and area. It is the history counterpart of FCLT_ROOMS, keyed by room plus a period code.

col_001.name: room_period_key
col_001.description: Primary key: room number (building-room, e.g. '3-261') concatenated with the snapshot period code '201505'.

col_002.name: snapshot_period
col_002.description: History period code for this snapshot; constant '201505' (May 2015) in this extract. Likely a YYYYMM-style period key.

col_003.name: room_number
col_003.description: Room identifier in MIT building-room format, e.g. '2-092' = building 2, room 092. Joins to FCLT_ROOMS.

col_004.name: room_number_dup
col_004.description: Duplicate of col_003 (room number); identical values in every sampled row. Possibly a separate 'room key' field that happens to equal the room number.

col_005.name: building_number

tags).
