Used as a lookup for external institutions (e.g., for transfer credit or peer comparisons) in an MIT-focused data warehouse.

col_001.name: institution_id
col_001.description: Primary key. Unique institution identifier; mostly numeric strings (e.g., IPEDS UNITID) but some alphanumeric codes (e.g., 'F06179', 'F01323') for non-US institutions.

col_002.name: institution_name
col_002.description: Full official name of the institution (e.g., 'Howard Payne University', 'Kyoto Women's University').

col_003.name: alternate_name
col_003.description: Alternate or commonly-used name of the institution; null for ~85% of rows. Could also be a branch/campus-specific name.

col_004.name: address_line
col_004.description: Street address of the institution (mixed-case and uppercase forms, US and international addresses).

col_005.name: city
col_005.description: City/locality of the institution (e.g., BROWNWOOD, MOSCOW, BEIJING).

col_006.name: postal_code
col_006.description: Postal/ZIP code; populated mainly for US addresses (null for most non-US rows). Some values include ZIP+4 (e.g., '32114-3900').

col_007.name: state_code
col_007.description: US state / territory postal code (CA, FL, TX, NY, PR, ...); null for non-US institutions.

col_008.name: country_code
col_008.description: Two-letter ISO country code (US, JP, CN, IN, RU, ...). The accepted join to TOP_LEVEL_DOMAIN is coincidental (both are 2-letter codes) and should not be treated as a real relationship.

col_009.name: country_name
col_009.description: Country name corresponding to col_008 (e.g., 'UNITED STATES', 'JAPAN').

col_010.name: carnegie_classification_code
col_010.description: Numeric Carnegie Classification code; -3 = 'Not applicable, not in Carnegie universe (not accredited or nondegree-granting)'. The accepted join to SPACE_USAGE is spurious (numeric overlap only) and should be ignored.

col_011.name: carnegie_classification_description
col_011.description: Text label of the Carnegie Classification matching col_010 (e.g., 'Master's Colleges and Universities (larger programs)', 'Associate's--Private For-profit', 'Tribal Colleges').

col_012.name: fips_country_code
col_012.description: FIPS 10-4 numeric country code (e.g., 900 for 'not applicable'/unknown? 999, 187=China? values like 138, 180, 8). Values 900/999 likely denote unknown/not reported. Exact code list not available, so specific mappings are inferred from co-occurrence with col_008 only.

col_013.name: load_date
col_013.description: Date the row was loaded/last refreshed, in DD-MON-YY form (e.g., '17-JUL-14', '16-JUL-24'); nearly all rows from a 2014 load with a small 2024 refresh.

table.name: LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR
table.purpose: Course reserve records linking a course offering (subject, term, instructor) to the MIT library placing materials on reserve for that course. Each row is one course-reserve instance per instructor per term, referenced by the reserve material detail table.

col_001.name: RESERVE_KEY
col_001.description: Primary key. Composite string of course number, instructor name, term code, and (cross-listed) subject number, e.g. '21F.107-KIDD2011SU:21F.107' = subject 21F.107, instructor Kidd, Fall 2011 (SU/FA/SP suffix), and the subject the reserve is filed under. Referenced by LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.

col_002.name: COURSE_TITLE
col_002.description: Title of the course/subject (e.g. 'Calculus', 'Chinese I (Streamlined)'). Matches LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED course title.

col_003.name: INSTRUCTOR_NAME
col_003.description: Instructor of the course, formatted 'Last, First' (e.g. 'Kidd, Audrey').

col_004.name: DEPARTMENT
col_004.description: Academic department owning the course, either as 'code - name' (e.g. '21F - Foreign Languages/Literatures') or plain name (e.g. 'History').

col_005.name: TERM_START_DATE
col_005.description: Start date of the academic term in which the course is offered (DD-MON-YY).

col_006.name: TERM_END_DATE
col_006.description: End date of the academic term (DD-MON-YY). Values like '31-MAY-31' suggest some placeholder/invalid dates.

col_007.name: RESERVE_LIBRARY_CODE
col_007.description: Code of the MIT library holding the course reserves: Hayden, ENG (Barker Engineering), DEW (Dewey), RTC (Rotch), MUS (Lewis Music); combined values like 'Hayden & ENG' when materials are split across libraries. Null when no library assignment.

col_008.name: RESERVE_LIBRARY_NAME
col_008.description: Full name of the library holding the reserves (Hayden, Barker, Dewey, Rotch, Lewis Music); paired 1:1 with col_007 codes. Null when col_007 is null.

col_009.name: RESERVE_PROCESS_DATE
col_009.description: Date the reserve list was processed/submitted to the library (DD-MON-YY), typically shortly before or during the term. Alternative reading: it could be an expiration or removal date for the reserve, though the timing pattern favors a processing/submission date.

table.name: LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS
table.purpose: Lookup table of status codes for library course reserve materials, mapping a one-letter code to a description of whether the material is required, optional, or unknown for a course. Referenced by LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.

col_001.name: material_status_code
col_001.description: One-letter code classifying a library reserve material's status (Y, U, R, O, N, X). Primary key; referenced by LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.col_004. Exact letter meanings beyond those implied by col_003 (N = Non-Required, O = Reserve only, U = Unknown) are not fully determinable.

col_002.name: material_status_code_display
col_002.description: Duplicate of col_001 (identical values in every row). Likely a display or copy of the status code; its separate purpose is unclear. The join from LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.col_004 points at the status code, which col_001 already serves, so this column's distinct role remains undetermined.

col_003.name: material_status_description
col_003.description: Human-readable description of the status: 'Required Course Material', 'Reserve only', 'No Required Textbook', 'Non-Required Course Material', 'Unknown'. One row has a null description (likely the X or Y code).

col_004.name: last_updated_date
col_004.description: Date the lookup was last updated; all rows show 23-DEC-21. Format DD-MON-YY suggests an Oracle-style date stored as text. No join evidence bears on this column, so the reading remains plausible but unconfirmed.

table.name: LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG
table.purpose: Library course reserves catalog: one row per item (book, video, personal copy, etc.) placed on reserve, with bibliographic metadata and reserve activity dates. Likely the catalog side of the LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL data.

col_001.name: reserve_item_id
col_001.description: Primary key; unique numeric identifier for the reserve catalog record.

col_002.name: title
col_002.description: Item title (library catalog style, 'Title / Author'). Some rows instead contain course cross-listing notes ('This course is cross-listed with ...'), so the field holds a general title/note for the reserve entry.

col_003.name: author
col_003.description: Author statement in catalog format (e.g. 'Shakespeare, William, 1564-1616.').

col_004.name: publication_year
col_004.description: Year of publication; 0 means unknown/missing. Values 1960-2020.

col_005.name: publication_imprint
col_005.description: Imprint (place : publisher, date) of the item.

col_006.name: call_number
col_006.description: Library call number (mostly LC class numbers like QA303.S5547 1996), with some special values like 'Professor Collection', 'Personal Copy', 'RESERVE VIDEO' indicating non-cataloged reserve copies.

col_007.name: isbn
col_007.description: ISBN/ISSN of the item, sometimes with qualifiers like '(pbk.)' or '(alk. paper)'.

col_008.name: reserve_item_id_copy
col_008.description: Duplicate of col_001 (identical values and distribution); likely a foreign key back to the same record or a redundant copy of the ID.

col_009.name: date_added
col_009.description: Date the item was placed on reserve (Oracle DD-MON-YY format).

col_010.name: date_removed
col_010.description: Date the item was taken off reserve; the dominant value 02-FEB-09 suggests a bulk removal/reload event.

col_012.name: last_updated_date
col_012.description: Date the record was last updated/loaded; dominant values (13-MAR-08, 03-FEB-09) look like batch update dates.

table.name: LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL
table.purpose: One row per course-reserve material item at the MIT Libraries: a specific material placed on reserve for a specific course-section/instructor and term, with its required-material status and the date the reserve list was published/loaded.

col_001.name: course_instructor_material_key
col_001.description: Composite key of course-instructor-term plus subject, e.g. '21M.262-PALMER2009FA:21M.262' (subject-INSTRUCTORterm:subject). References LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR.

col_002.name: reserve_material_id
col_002.description: Numeric ID of the individual reserve material/item (likely a library catalog/bib record ID); mostly unique per row. No joined neighbours provide further evidence, so the exact source of the ID remains unconfirmed.

col_003.name: subject_term_key
col_003.description: Subject number concatenated with term code, e.g. '21M.2622009FA' — course-section/term identifier.

col_004.name: material_status_code
col_004.description: Required-material status: U=Unknown, N=Non-Required Course Material, O=Reserve only, X=No Required Textbook, Y=Required Course Material. References LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS.

col_005.name: term_code
col_005.description: Academic term code (e.g. 2009FA = Fall 2009, 2009SP = Spring, SU = Summer, JA = January/IAP). References ACADEMIC_TERMS.

col_006.name: subject_number
col_006.description: MIT subject/course number, e.g. '21M.240', 'HST.S11'.

col_007.name: reserve_list_date
col_007.description: Date associated with the term's reserve list (e.g. 05-DEC-08 for 2009FA), likely the date the reserve list was submitted/published; exact semantics (submission vs. effective date) not confirmed. No joined neighbours provide further evidence.

table.name: LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED
table.purpose: Library-oriented extract of MIT subject (course) offerings per academic term: one row per subject offering, with subject code, title, owning/administering department, school, instructor, and enrollment count. Likely used to link library reserve materials to courses. The final extract date column suggests a snapshot loaded on 19-DEC-24.

col_001.name: offering_id
col_001.description: Primary key: concatenation of subject number and term code (e.g. '10.543' + '2014SP'), uniquely identifying a subject offering in a term.

col_002.name: term_code
col_002.description: Academic term code (YYYY + FA/SP/SU/JA for fall/spring/summer/January IAP). References ACADEMIC_TERMS.

col_003.name: subject_dept_code
col_003.description: Course/subject department code of the subject number (e.g. 15=Management, 21F=Foreign Languages). References SIS_SUBJECT_CODE / STUDENT_DEPARTMENT.

col_004.name: subject_dept_code_padded
col_004.description: Same as col_003 but right-aligned/padded with leading spaces (fixed-width copy).

col_005.name: subject_dept_name
col_005.description: Department name corresponding to col_003 (e.g. 15 -> Management).

col_006.name: subject_number
col_006.description: Full subject (course) number, e.g. 18.085, 21F.301.

col_007.name: subject_number_padded
col_007.description: Same subject number as col_006, padded variant.

col_008.name: admin_dept_code
col_008.description: Code of the department administering/offering the subject (may differ from the subject's own course code, e.g. 7.88 administered by 10). References STUDENT_DEPARTMENT / SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.

col_009.name: admin_dept_code_padded
col_009.description: Padded copy of col_008.

col_010.name: admin_dept_name
col_010.description: Name of the administering department (corresponds to col_008).

col_011.name: offering_subject_number
col_011.description: Subject number as offered in this term; slightly more distinct values than col_006 (includes variants like 18.100B), i.e. the specific offering's catalog number.

col_012.name: offering_subject_number_padded
col_012.description: Padded copy of col_011.

col_013.name: subject_title
col_013.description: Title of the subject, e.g. 'Protein Folding& Human Disease', 'Mathematical Statistics'.

col_014.name: admin_dept_code_2
col_014.description: Duplicate of col_008 (administering department code); also joins SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.

col_015.name: admin_dept_name_2
col_015.description: Duplicate of col_010, but with a slightly different department-name rendering (e.g. 'Global Studies & Languages' vs 'Foreign Languages/Literatures'), likely from the admin-department lookup.

col_016.name: school_name
col_016.description: MIT school of the administering department: Hum, Arts & Social Sciences; Engineering; Science; Sloan School of Management; Architecture and Planning.

col_017.name: instructor_name
col_017.description: Instructor of the offering, in 'Last, First' format. Null for ~1% of rows (offerings without an assigned instructor).

col_018.name: instructor_id
col_018.description: Numeric identifier (MIT ID-like, 9-digit) of the instructor; nulls align with col_017. Pairs 1:1 with instructor names.

col_019.name: enrollment
col_019.description: Number of students enrolled in the offering (0 to 673, median 12).

col_020.name: extract_date
col_020.description: Date the data was extracted/loaded, constant '19-DEC-24' (19 Dec 2024) across all rows.

table.name: MASTER_DEPT_DCODE_PARENT
table.purpose: A master list of MIT department/organizational DLC codes (D-codes) with each unit's name and its parent (top-level) organizational unit, as of a snapshot date. Each row is one department, lab, or center (DLC) mapped to its parent area (e.g., School of Engineering, VP Research). It is referenced by hierarchy, HR org, facilities, and space tables as the canonical D-code lookup. The table name suggests it pairs each D-code with its parent D-code; the snapshot date column indicates a point-in-time extract rather than a full history (unlike MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY).

col_001.name: dept_dcode_number
col_001.description: Numeric identifier for the department/DLC, the numeric counterpart of the D-code (col_002). Primary key; unique per row. Referenced implicitly by hierarchy tables via the D-code.

col_002.name: dept_dcode
col_002.description: Department/DLC code (e.g., D_AEROASTRO, D_MTL), prefixed 'D_'. Canonical key referenced by MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY, MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY_LINKS, HR_ORG_UNIT, SIS_DEPARTMENT, facilities and space tables.

col_003.name: dept_name
col_003.description: Full name of the department, lab, or center (e.g., 'Whitehead Institute', 'Office of Experiential Learning').

col_004.name: parent_dcode_number
col_004.description: Numeric identifier of the parent (top-level) organizational unit; values match col_001 values of parent rows (e.g., 12259 = School of Engineering). 31 distinct parents.

col_005.name: parent_dcode
col_005.description: D-code of the parent/top-level organizational unit (e.g., D_SCHOOL_ENG, D_VPRES). Pairs with col_004.

col_006.name: parent_name
col_006.description: Name of the parent/top-level organizational unit (e.g., 'School of Engineering', 'VP Research').

col_007.name: snapshot_date
col_007.description: Date of the data extract/snapshot, constant '19-DEC-24' across all rows; indicates this table reflects the hierarchy as of 19 December 2024.

table.name: MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY
table.purpose: Master list of MIT department/organizational units (DLCs) with their position in the standard administrative hierarchy: top-level 'All Departments', senior officer area (e.g. Provost, EVP), and intermediate grouping (school/VP area). One row per department code. Referenced widely by HR, SIS, space, and facilities tables as the canonical department key.

col_001.name: hierarchy_name
col_001.description: Name of the hierarchy this row belongs to; constant 'Standard Hierarchy' for all rows.

col_002.name: department_code
col_002.description: Primary key. Department (DLC) code, e.g. D_PSFC, D_MATHS, D_AEROASTRO. Canonical department identifier referenced by many other tables.

col_003.name: department_code_display
col_003.description: Duplicate of the department code (col_002); identical values in all rows. Possibly a display/alternate-key copy.

col_004.name: department_name
col_004.description: Full name of the department/unit, e.g. 'Plasma Sciences & Fusion Center', 'Mathematics'.

col_005.name: top_level_code
col_005.description: Code of the top-level hierarchy node; constant 'D_ALL' for all rows.

col_006.name: top_level_name
col_006.description: Name of the top-level hierarchy node; constant 'All Departments'.

col_007.name: area_code
col_007.description: Code of the senior-officer area the department reports to (e.g. D_PROVOST_AREA, D_EXECVP_AREA, D_PRES_AREA).

col_008.name: area_name
col_008.description: Name of the senior-officer area, e.g. 'Provost Area', "Executive Vice President's Area".

col_009.name: group_code
col_009.description: Code of the intermediate grouping (school or VP area) the department belongs to, e.g. D_SCHOOL_ENG, D_VPRES, D_DSL. Null when no grouping applies.

col_010.name: group_name
col_010.description: Name of the intermediate grouping, e.g. 'School of Engineering', 'VP Research', 'Dean for Student Life'. Nulls align with col_009.

col_011.name: subgroup_code
col_011.description: Code of a finer sub-grouping level; populated only for a few departments (D_OSATT_AREA, D_SOURCING_AREA), otherwise null. Joins to MASTER_DEPT_DCODE_PARENT's dept_dcode, so it is a D_-prefixed hierarchy code, but the join evidence does not distinguish whether it is a sub-grouping code or a parent-area code; the sparse population pattern supports the sub-grouping reading.

col_012.name: subgroup_name
col_012.description: Name of the sub-grouping level ('Office of Strategic Alliances & Tech Transfer Area', 'Sourcing Area'); nulls align with col_011. Alternative reading: name of a parent area rather than a sub-grouping, since the paired code joins to the canonical D-code lookup.

table.name: MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY_LINKS
table.purpose: Link/edge table mapping individual funds centers (or org units / profit centers) to their parent department code within MIT's standard department hierarchy. Each row is a node-to-parent-department link in one of several hierarchy types (funds center, profit center, org units, BAG).

col_001.name: hierarchy_name
col_001.description: Name of the hierarchy the link belongs to; constant 'Standard Hierarchy' in all rows.

col_002.name: hierarchy_type_code
col_002.description: Code identifying the hierarchy/source system of the node: FC (funds center), PMIT (PCMIT-0 profit center), ORG2 (new org unit), ORG (old org unit), BAG (NIMBUS B.A.G.), SIS, FORG. Exact meanings of SIS/FORG unresolved.

col_003.name: hierarchy_type_description
col_003.description: Human-readable label of the hierarchy type corresponding to col_002 (e.g. 'Standard Funds Center', 'PCMIT-0 Profit Center', 'New Org. Unit', 'Old Org. Unit', 'NIMBUS B.A.G.').

col_004.name: parent_department_code
col_004.description: Parent department code (D_ prefixed, e.g. D_EECS, D_MECHE) in the master department hierarchy; references MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY / MASTER_DEPT_DCODE_PARENT.

col_005.name: child_department_code
col_005.description: Department code of the linked node; references MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.department_code and MASTER_DEPT_DCODE_PARENT.dept_dcode. Identical to col_004 in samples, so parent vs child assignment between col_004/col_005 is uncertain — it may be a duplicate of the parent department code rather than a distinct child.

col_006.name: node_id
col_006.description: Identifier of the hierarchy node being linked (e.g. funds center codes FC_CEE58, FC203103, profit center P151080-001). Nearly unique per row.

col_007.name: node_id_duplicate
col_007.description: Same value as col_006 in all observed rows; likely a redundant copy of the node/funds-center identifier. Whether it ever differs is unresolved.

table.name: MIT_HOLIDAY_CLOSING_CALENDAR
table.purpose: Calendar of MIT institute holidays, emergency closings, and special closings, one row per closing date. Dates span roughly 2006–2029, apparently loaded/refreshed on 19-DEC-24 (col_004).

col_001.name: closing_date
col_001.description: Date of the holiday/closing, stored as text in DD-MON-YY Oracle format (e.g. 25-NOV-27 = Nov 25, 2027). Primary key; joins to TIME_DAY date dimension. Duplicates like 01-JAN-23 appearing twice suggest the same date can carry two closings (e.g. New Year's observed on one date under two labels).

col_002.name: holiday_name_or_code
col_002.description: Name of the holiday/closing, e.g. 'MIT Christmas Day', 'MIT Patriots' Day', 'MIT Day After Thanksgiving'. Some rows hold short codes instead: 'EMER' (emergency closing, 86 rows) and 'SHOL' (special holiday/closing, 62 rows), matching the counts of those categories in col_003 — so when the closing has no named holiday, the category code is stored here.

col_003.name: closing_type
col_003.description: Category of the entry: 'Standard Holiday' (432), 'Emergency Closing' (86, rows named EMER), or 'Special Holiday/Closing' (62, rows named SHOL).

col_004.name: last_refreshed_date
col_004.description: Constant value '19-DEC-24' on all 580 rows; likely the date the calendar snapshot was loaded or last updated. Could alternatively be a nominal 'record added' date, but a load/refresh timestamp is the most plausible reading.

table.name: MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY
table.purpose: A snapshot (dated 19-DEC-24) of the MIT student directory: one row per enrolled student, listing name parts, directory display name, contact info, department, and class year. Department codes join to STUDENT_DEPARTMENT for labels.

col_001.name: first_name
col_001.description: Student's first (given) name.

col_002.name: middle_name
col_002.description: Student's middle name or middle initial (single letters like 'H', 'B', 'M' are initials; full names also appear). Null for ~58% of students.

col_003.name: last_name
col_003.description: Student's last (family) name.

col_004.name: full_name
col_004.description: Display name in 'Last, First [Middle]' format, e.g. 'Mann, Nina'.

col_005.name: office_room
col_005.description: MIT building-room code (e.g. 'E15-381D', '26-226D') for the student's office/lab room; populated for only ~3.6% of rows (likely grad students with offices).

col_006.name: phone_number
col_006.description: A phone number stored as digits (10-digit values, some longer, possibly with country/extension digits). Populated for only ~0.5% of rows; exact type (office vs. mobile) unresolved.

col_007.name: email_address
col_007.description: Student's email address (synthetic domain 'worker.com' in this data).

col_008.name: department_code
col_008.description: MIT course/department number code (e.g. '6' = EECS, '15' = Management, '16' = AeroAstro); references STUDENT_DEPARTMENT.col_001.

col_009.name: department_name
col_009.description: Human-readable department name corresponding to the department code (denormalized label from STUDENT_DEPARTMENT).

col_010.name: class_year_code
col_010.description: Class-year code: 'G' for graduate students (62.75%), '1'-'4' for undergraduate freshman through senior classes.

col_011.name: full_name_upper
col_011.description: Uppercase version of the full display name ('LAST, FIRST [MIDDLE]'), likely used for sorting/searching.

col_012.name: snapshot_date
col_012.description: Date the directory snapshot was taken, '19-DEC-24' for all rows (DD-MON-YY format).

table.name: MOIRA_LIST
table.purpose: MIT Moira mailing list system: one row per mailing list, with its name and Y/N flag settings (visibility, membership, moderation, etc.). Detail rows (members) live in MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL, which references this table by list name.

col_001.name: list_name
col_001.description: Unique name of the Moira mailing list (hyphenated word tokens). Primary identifier; MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL rows (list members) reference it.

col_002.name: list_name_copy
col_002.description: Exact duplicate of col_001 (identical distribution and values) — likely a second copy of the list name, e.g. a display/canonical name column that always matches.

col_004.name: active_flag
col_004.description: Y/N flag, always 'Y' in sample. Plausibly an 'active/enabled' indicator for the list, but since it never varies, its specific meaning cannot be confirmed.

col_005.name: public_flag
col_005.description: Y/N flag, mostly Y (87.7%). Could be list visibility/public flag; other readings (e.g. 'mail enabled') fit equally.

table.name: MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL
table.purpose: Membership detail for Moira (MIT's list/email-list management system) mailing lists: one row per member (user or email address) of a Moira list, with the member's identity, the date they were added, and an active flag. Joins to MOIRA_LIST for the list itself and to MOIRA_LIST_OWNER for the owning list/user entity.

col_001.name: list_name
col_001.description: Name of the Moira list this membership belongs to; references MOIRA_LIST.col_001 (many memberships per list). Values are hyphenated list names like 'orange-rabbit'.

col_002.name: owner_list_or_user_id
col_002.description: Identifier of the entity that owns/administers this list membership record, prefixed 'LIST' or 'USER' (e.g. 'LISTradiant-meadow', 'USERdate-raspberry'); references MOIRA_LIST_OWNER.col_001 (LIST_OWNER_KEY), where it forms the owner portion of that table's composite key. For USER-prefixed rows it may denote the member's personal (self-owned) list.

col_003.name: member_identifier
col_003.description: The list member's identifier: either an MIT username (e.g. 'aaliyahs', 'athenah') or an external email address (e.g. 'hr@yahoo.com'). Referenced by SE_PERSON and WAREHOUSE_USERS, so it matches person/user identifiers elsewhere.

col_004.name: member_full_name
col_004.description: Full name of the list member in 'Last, First' format (e.g. 'Sloan, Aaliyah'). Null for members given only as external email addresses.

col_005.name: mit_id
col_005.description: 9-digit MIT personal ID number (range 900000000-999999999) of the member; null for external email members. Consistent with MIT ID numbering seen in person tables. Alternative reading: could be some other 9-digit numeric identifier, but MIT ID is the most plausible.

col_006.name: date_added
col_006.description: Date the member was added to the list, in DD-MON-YY Oracle format (e.g. '19-DEC-13').

col_007.name: active_flag
col_007.description: Flag indicating the membership is active; constant value 1 in this extract.

col_008.name: snapshot_date
col_008.description: Date the record was loaded/refreshed into the warehouse; constant '19-DEC-24' across all rows, i.e. the extract date rather than a per-row business date.

table.name: MOIRA_LIST_OWNER
table.purpose: Maps owners (lists, users, or Kerberos principals) to Moira mailing lists. Moira is MIT's list and account management system; each row records one owner of a list, keyed by a composite of list name and owner name, with a snapshot date. The referenced MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL table holds the list membership/details, and this table identifies who owns each list. Note: values appear anonymized/synthesized (list names replaced with generated word-number strings), so exact real-world values are not observable, but the structure is clear.

col_001.name: LIST_OWNER_KEY

table.name: OPA_PERSON_CURRENT

table.name: SE_PERSON

col_001.name: mit_id

col_002.name: username

col_003.name: display_name

col_004.name: appointment_category

col_006.name: active_flag

col_007.name: office_room

col_008.name: department_name

col_009.name: first_name

col_010.name: last_name

col_011.name: middle_name

col_012.name: person_group

col_001.name: extract_date
col_001.description: Snapshot/extract date of the table load; constant '19-DEC-24' on all rows.

col_002.name: department_code
col_002.description: Primary key: MIT department/administrative unit code (e.g. AERO, 21F, 15D, BAP). Referenced by subject, course catalog, and student degree program tables.

col_003.name: department_name

col_005.name: account_number
col_005.description: 7-digit financial account number (likely cost/account number) associated with the department; null for most administrative units. Exact account type not determinable.

col_006.name: secondary_account_number
col_006.description: 7-digit secondary financial account number (values cluster around 1.1M-1.6M, some ~3.9M); possibly a cost object or fund account. Exact meaning not determinable.

col_007.name: effective_date
col_007.description: Date the department record was created or last made effective (Oracle-style DD-MON-YY dates, mostly 1990s-2000s). Could be a last-update date; creation date is the more likely reading given the historical values.

table.name: SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION
table.purpose: MIT SIS table of degree-program/course-of-study descriptions: one row per department + program + level combination, with department, school, effective term range, CIP code, degree type, and load dates. col_001.name: program_key
col_001.description: Primary key: colon-joined composite of department code, program/sub-plan code (optional), and level (G=graduate, U=undergraduate), e.g. '10::G', '3:P:G', 'HST:AEM:G'.

col_002.name: dept_program_code
col_002.description: Department code concatenated with the program/sub-plan code (e.g. '3 P', 'HST AEM', '1 NIE'); the human-readable form of the key components.

col_003.name: program_short_description
col_003.description: Short description of the program/degree track, combining department and program (e.g. 'Mat Sci & Eng - M.Eng', 'HST - MD & MIT MEMP - Master').

col_004.name: department_full_name
col_004.description: Full department name (e.g. 'Materials Science and Engineering', 'Health Sciences and Technology').

col_005.name: department_code
col_005.description: MIT department code (e.g. 1=Civil & Environmental Eng, 12=EAPS, 15=Management, HST); references STUDENT_DEPARTMENT.

col_006.name: department_short_name
col_006.description: Abbreviated department name matching the STUDENT_DEPARTMENT lookup label (e.g. 'Earth, Atmos & Planetary Sci', 'Management').

col_007.name: department_long_name
col_007.description: Formal department name with prefix, e.g. 'Department of Linguistics and Philosophy', 'Sloan School of Management'; null for some non-departmental programs.

col_008.name: school_short_name
col_008.description: Short school/college grouping: Engineering, Science, Hum Arts & Social Sciences, Architecture and Planning, Sloan, Schwarzman College of Computing, Non-MIT, etc.

col_009.name: school_full_name
col_009.description: Full school name corresponding to col_008 (e.g. 'School of Engineering', 'Whitaker College of Health Sciences and Technology').

col_010.name: effective_term_code
col_010.description: Start term code of the program record ('000000' = Beginning of Time); references ACADEMIC_TERMS.

col_011.name: effective_term_name
col_011.description: Start term name matching col_010 (e.g. 'Fall Term 2000-2001', 'Beginning of Time').

col_012.name: end_term_code
col_012.description: End term code of the record ('999999' = End of Time, i.e. currently active); references ACADEMIC_TERMS.

col_013.name: end_term_name
col_013.description: End term name matching col_012 (e.g. 'End of Time', 'Summer Term 2018').

col_014.name: program_code
col_014.description: Sub-plan / program code within the department (e.g. 'P' M.Eng plan, 'AEM', 'NIE' non-Institute exchange, 'TP' Technology & Policy); null when the row is the department's default program.

col_015.name: level_code
col_015.description: Level of study: 'G' = graduate, 'U' = undergraduate.

col_016.name: cip_code
col_016.description: NCES CIP (Classification of Instructional Programs) code for the program, e.g. 142701 human-computer interaction, 140501 bioengineering; references CIP.

col_017.name: degree_granting_flag
col_017.description: Y/N flag; plausibly whether the program grants a degree (vs. non-degree programs like NIV/NIE exchange which are 'N'). Exact semantics not confirmed.

col_018.name: degree_code
col_018.description: MIT degree abbreviation: SB, SM, DOC, MNG, MCP, MBA, HA, etc.; 'NDG' = no degree granted.

col_019.name: degree_level_1
col_019.description: Degree level: 'Masters' or 'Doctoral'; null for non-degree/undergraduate rows. Duplicates col_020.

col_020.name: degree_level_2
col_020.description: Duplicate of col_019: 'Masters' or 'Doctoral', null otherwise.

col_021.name: last_updated_date
col_021.description: Date the record was last updated, DD-MON-YY format (e.g. '23-JUL-15').

col_022.name: load_date
col_022.description: Warehouse extract/load date; constant '19-DEC-24' across all rows.

table.name: SIS_DEPARTMENT

col_001.name: department_code
col_001.description: Short department code (e.g. '21F' Foreign Languages & Literatures, 'ARC', 'HASS', 'ODGE' Office of the Dean for Graduate Education). Nearly unique (127 distinct of 128, one null); likely the natural key of the table.

col_002.name: department_name
col_002.description: Short/abbreviated department name, e.g. 'History', 'Anthropology', 'Residential Life', 'Nuclear Engineering'.

col_003.name: department_code_name
col_003.description: Concatenated code and name ('1-Civil and Environmental Eng', '21L-Literature'), unique per row; the join key referenced by STUDENT_DEPARTMENT and SUBJECT_GROUPING.

col_004.name: school_group_code
col_004.description: Single-letter code for the department's group/school category; pairs with col_005 (Y=MIT academic, E=Engineering, H=Humanities/Arts/Social Sciences, Z=Non-MIT, X=MIT non-academic).

col_005.name: school_group_name
col_005.description: Label for the group code: 'MIT, academic', 'Engineering', 'Hum, Arts & Social Sciences', 'Non-MIT', 'MIT, non-academic', plus college-level labels (Whitaker/HST, Schwarzman).

col_006.name: org_unit_number

col_007.name: active_flag

col_008.name: long_name
col_008.description: Full formal department name ('Department of Aeronautics and Astronautics', 'Program in System Design and Management'); null for over half the rows where the short name suffices.

col_009.name: school_name
col_009.description: MIT school the department belongs to (School of Engineering, School of Science, School of Humanities, Arts, and Social Sciences, School of Architecture and Planning, Sloan, Schwarzman College of Computing, Whitaker College of HST).

col_010.name: historical_note
col_010.description: Free-text historical/renaming notes ('was BEH', 'Anthropol/Archaeol until 1998-99', 'associated with school of engineering through 5th week of 1998SP'); sparsely populated.

col_011.name: effective_date
col_011.description: Date the department record became effective (Oracle DD-MON-YY format); 17-FEB-94 dominates, suggesting a bulk load of legacy departments on that date.

col_012.name: hierarchy_code

col_013.name: warehouse_load_date
col_013.description: Constant '19-DEC-24' on all rows: date the data was loaded/refreshed into the warehouse.

table.name: SIS_LOOKUP

col_001.name: lookup_category

col_002.name: code

col_004.name: snapshot_date

table.name: SIS_SUBJECT_CODE

col_002.name: subject_code_duplicate

col_003.name: subject_name

col_004.name: department_code

col_005.description: Name of the owning department corresponding to col_004, e.g. 'Urban Studies and Planning', 'Non-Institute-MFA/MCA', 'Wellesley Cross-Enrollment Pro'.

col_006.name: school_code
col_006.description: Code for the school/area classification of the subject: 'Z' (Non-MIT), 'E' (Engineering), 'H' (Hum, Arts & Social Sciences), 'S' (Science), 'A' (Architecture and Planning), etc.

col_007.name: school_name
col_007.description: Name of the school/area corresponding to col_006, e.g. 'Non-MIT', 'Engineering', 'Hum, Arts & Social Sciences', 'Architecture and Planning', 'Whitaker Coll of HST; HST', 'Schwarzman Coll of Comp'.

col_008.name: extract_date
col_008.description: Constant date value '19-DEC-24' on every row; appears to be the date the snapshot/extract was loaded (warehouse load date), not a per-row attribute. table.name: SIS_TERM_ADDRESS_CATEGORY
table.purpose: Lookup/reference table of MIT student term-address categories (mostly dormitories, fraternities, sororities, and independent living groups) used by the Student Information System to classify student term addresses. One row per address category code, with category type and effective/expiration dates. Despite the name, it contains no term or academic-session columns; it appears to be the code list behind term address assignment in SIS. The 'TERM' in the name likely refers to 'term address' (student's address during term) rather than academic terms, since no columns join to ACADEMIC_TERMS and all values are residence categories like dorms, fraternities, and ILGs. This reading is tentative; an alternative is that it categorizes addresses per academic term, but no term identifier column exists to support that.

col_001.name: address_category_code
col_001.description: Primary key: short alphanumeric code identifying a term-address category (e.g. PKA = pika, WGA = Westgate, VAS, PKT, SAE, NUD, PBP). Mostly 2-4 letter codes; some rows show numeric-looking values (405, 407, 500, 70, 99) which are likely street-number-based codes for address categories like '405 Memorial Dr'.

col_002.name: address_category_name
col_002.description: Human-readable name of the address category: dormitory names (Westgate Lowrise, Graduate Junction), fraternity/sorority names (Kappa Alpha Theta, Kappa Sigma, Alpha Phi, Theta Delta Chi, Delta Psi), ILGs (pika), and street addresses (405 Memorial Dr, Cambridge 02139). Not unique (Westgate Lowrise appears 10 times, likely one row per building/section sharing a name).

col_003.name: address_type_code
col_003.description: Single-letter code for the category type: D = Dormitory, F = Fraternity, S = Sorority, I = ILG (Independent Living Group), O = Off Campus. Mapping confirmed by col_004 correspondence. Nulls (8%) correspond to rows where the type is 'Unknown'.

col_004.name: address_type_description
col_004.description: Text description of the category type: Dormitory, Fraternity, Sorority, ILG, Off Campus, or Unknown. Pairs 1:1 with col_003 (D/F/S/I/O), with 'Unknown' covering the 9 rows where col_003 is null.

col_005.name: effective_date
col_005.description: Date (stored as text, DD-MON-YY Oracle format) the category became effective/active. '01-JAN-60' is a default/placeholder date. Most dates cluster in the 1990s when the list was set up, with a few recent additions (e.g. 06-OCT-23 for Graduate Junction).

col_006.name: expiration_date
col_006.description: Date (DD-MON-YY text) the category expired/was retired; null for ~85% of rows, i.e. still active. Non-null values (e.g. 01-JAN-15, 01-JAN-94) mark discontinued categories. Could alternatively be a 'date removed from use' audit field, but expiration is the standard reading.

col_007.name: last_updated_date
col_007.description: Date (DD-MON-YY text) the row was last modified/added. Values track the effective dates plus later updates (e.g. 20-SEP-24 for the newly added Graduate Junction).

col_008.name: warehouse_load_date
col_008.description: Date (DD-MON-YY text) the row was loaded/refreshed into the warehouse; constant '19-DEC-24' across all 112 rows, indicating the last full extract.

col_006.name: room_id_duplicate
col_006.description: Duplicate of col_005 (same values in all samples, same distribution) - full room identifier 'building-room'.

col_008.name: room_area_sqft
col_008.description: Room area, almost certainly in square feet (values 1 to 108,475, median 147, consistent with individual room sizes).

col_009.name: active_flag

col_010.name: building_number
col_010.description: Building number, referencing FAC_BUILDING / FCLT_BUILDING (e.g. '10', '13', '32', with a few alpha-suffixed codes like '42T').

col_011.name: snapshot_date
col_011.description: Snapshot/extract date of the data; constant '19-DEC-24' (December 19, 2024) across all rows, indicating this is a point-in-time extract.

col_001.name: floor_code

col_002.name: floor_code_duplicate
col_002.description: Duplicate of col_001 (identical values in all rows); likely a second copy of the floor code, possibly from a join or view definition.

col_004.name: extract_date
col_004.description: Constant value '19-DEC-24' on every row; appears to be a snapshot/extract date for the whole lookup rather than a per-row attribute. Ambiguous between the date the data was extracted and the as-of date of the snapshot; no join evidence distinguishes the two readings.

col_001.name: usage_id
col_001.description: Primary key; unique numeric identifier (9-digit) for each space usage record.

col_002.name: line_number
col_002.description: Sequence/line number within a record group; almost always 1, occasionally 2-4, suggesting multiple allocation lines per space. Alternative reading: a sub-line index splitting one room's usage across multiple room-use types.

col_004.name: room_use_type_code

col_005.name: room_area_sqft
col_005.description: Room/space area in square feet (0 to ~215,723; median 159).

col_006.name: charge_amount
col_006.description: Dollar amount associated with the space (charge/recharge/cost), often 0, ranging to ~9.5M with some negative adjustments. Alternative reading: a budgeted or allocated amount rather than an actual charge.

col_007.name: assigned_area_sqft
col_007.description: Assigned/usable square footage; closely tracks room_area_sqft (same top values and max), likely the area credited to the DLC after adjustments. Alternative reading: a duplicate copy of the room area rather than a distinct assigned measure.

col_008.name: area_adjustment
col_008.description: Small square-foot adjustment/correction; nearly always 0, a few values like -18, 1, 5. Alternative reading: a rounding or reconciliation delta between measured and assigned area.

col_001.name: space_unit_id
col_001.description: Primary key: sequential numeric identifier (101-287) for the space-occupying unit; referenced one-to-one by FAC_ORGANIZATION.

col_002.name: org_number
col_002.description: Organization/DLC number (e.g. 874100, 401812) identifying the unit in facilities and space systems; referenced by SPACE_DETAIL, ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD, FAC/FCLT_ORGANIZATION and other space tables. Duplicates col_003.

col_003.name: org_number_duplicate
col_003.description: Exact duplicate of col_002 (same values, same joins): the organization number of the space unit.

col_004.name: unit_name

col_005.name: unit_dcode

col_006.name: snapshot_date
col_006.description: Constant value '19-DEC-24' on all rows: the date this extract/snapshot of the space unit list was taken. Could also be a last-updated date; the constant value supports snapshot date more strongly.

table.name: SPACE_UNIT2
table.purpose: A snapshot of space-occupying organizational units at MIT: each row is a space unit (department, lab, or center) with its numeric space unit code, name, and department code. col_001.name: space_unit_code
col_001.description: Numeric code identifying the space unit (department/lab/center that occupies space). Primary key of this table; matches SPACE_UNIT's unit code.

col_002.name: space_unit_code_duplicate
col_002.description: Identical duplicate of col_001 (same values, same statistics) — the same space unit code stored twice, likely a legacy or join-convenience column.

col_003.name: space_unit_name
col_003.description: Name of the space unit (e.g. LITERATURE, MCGOVERN INSTITUTE, CAREER SERVICES). Joins to FAC_ORGANIZATION's organization name.

col_004.name: department_code
col_004.description: MIT department code prefixed with 'D_' (e.g. D_LIT, D_MECHE, D_CHANCELLOR), linking the space unit to the master department hierarchy. Null for ~5% of units (likely non-departmental units).

col_005.name: snapshot_date
col_005.description: Date the snapshot was taken/loaded, '19-DEC-24' on every row. Format is DD-MON-YY; stored as text.

table.name: SPACE_USAGE
table.purpose: A small lookup/code table of room/space usage categories (e.g., research room, training room, design studio) used to classify spaces in the facilities space data. Each row is one usage category with a numeric code and a short label. The single date value suggests a snapshot or last-updated date for the reference data.

col_001.name: usage_code
col_001.description: Primary key: numeric identifier for the space usage category. Referenced by space tables (SPACE_DETAIL, SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE) as a foreign key; the many other statistical joins to unrelated tables are spurious.

col_002.name: usage_description
col_002.description: Short label of the space usage category, e.g. 'RSRC RM' (resource room), 'RESEARCH CENTER', 'DSGN STUDIO' (design studio), 'TRNG RM' (training room), 'DINING RM' (dining room).

col_003.name: snapshot_date
col_003.description: Date value '19-DEC-24' present on every row; likely the date the reference data was loaded or last updated (snapshot date). Could also be an effective date for the codes, but the constant value across all rows supports a load/update date reading. No joins provide further evidence.

table.name: STUDENT_DEGREE_PROGRAM
table.purpose: Reference/dimension table of MIT degree programs: one row per degree program code, with degree level, administering department and school, course (curriculum) designations, and effective/expiration dates. It is a catalog of degree programs, not per-student enrollment records (no student identifiers present).

col_001.name: degree_program_code
col_001.description: Unique short code for the degree program (e.g. PHD, SMWS12, SB10B, SM15MT). Not fully unique here (357 distinct / 1202 rows), likely because rows also vary by effective term.

col_002.name: degree_program_long_description
col_002.description: Full official long name of the degree program (e.g. 'Doctor of Philosophy', 'Bachelor of Science in Chemical-Biological Engineering').

col_003.name: degree_program_short_description
col_003.description: Alternate/abbreviated official description of the degree program; same meaning as col_002 but with shortened wording (e.g. 'w/o spec of field').

col_004.name: degree_code
col_004.description: Abbreviated degree-level code: SB (Bachelor), SM (Master of Science), PHD, SCD, ENG, MBA, MCP, etc.

col_005.name: degree_name
col_005.description: Full name of the degree level corresponding to col_004 (e.g. 'Master of Science', 'Bachelor of Science').

col_006.name: degree_level_code
col_006.description: Numeric code for degree level: 1 = Bachelor (all SB rows), 3 = Master (SM rows), 8 = Doctoral (PHD/SCD), 6 = Engineer degree, 5 = other graduate (MCP/MBA etc.). Inferred from pairing with col_004/col_005 in samples; no join evidence available, so this reading remains tentative.

col_007.name: effective_term
col_007.description: Academic term (YYYY + FA/SP/SU) in which the degree program became effective; '000000' appears to mean no effective term / always active. Joins to ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.

col_008.name: expiration_term
col_008.description: Academic term in which the degree program expired/was terminated; '999999' means not expired (still active). Joins to ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.

col_009.name: department_code
col_009.description: Code of the administering academic department (MIT course number, e.g. 12 = Earth, Atmospheric & Planetary Sciences, 6 = EECS, 15 = Management). Joins to STUDENT_DEPARTMENT.

col_010.name: department_name
col_010.description: Full name of the administering department/school/program (e.g. 'Department of Mechanical Engineering', 'Sloan School of Management').

col_011.name: school_name
col_011.description: MIT school the program belongs to (School of Engineering, School of Science, etc.).

col_012.name: course_curriculum_code
col_012.description: Course/curriculum designation combining MIT course number and option letter (e.g. '2 M', '10 B', '21 CMS'). Corresponds to col_015 in coded form; no join evidence available, so this reading remains tentative.

col_013.name: career_level
col_013.description: Undergraduate vs graduate indicator: 'U' = undergraduate (all SB rows), 'G' = graduate.

col_014.name: joint_degree_flag
col_014.description: Y/N flag; likely indicates a joint or special program (e.g. MIT-WHOI joint degrees). Exact criterion not directly evidenced and no join evidence is available, so this reading remains tentative.

col_015.name: course_designation
col_015.description: MIT course designation in roman numerals (Course XII, Course VI-P, Course X-B), i.e. the curriculum the degree is granted under.

col_016.name: degree_course_display
col_016.description: Combined display string of degree abbreviation and course (e.g. 'S.M., Without Spec.', 'Ph.D., Course VII').

col_017.name: effective_date
col_017.description: Date the degree program record became effective, stored as text in DD-MON-YY format.

col_018.name: expiration_date
col_018.description: Date the degree program record expired, stored as text in DD-MON-YY format.

col_019.name: last_extract_date
col_019.description: Constant value '19-DEC-24' on all rows; date the data was extracted/loaded from the source system.

table.name: STUDENT_DEPARTMENT
table.purpose: Lookup table of MIT academic departments/programs (by course number code) that students can be affiliated with, each classified into a school/area grouping. Referenced by student, subject, and course catalog tables as the department code. 79 rows, one per department/program code (MIT course numbers plus special non-MIT/exchange codes).

col_001.name: department_code
col_001.description: Primary key: MIT course/department number code (e.g. '1' = Civil & Environmental Engineering, '12' = EAPS, '21L' = Literature) or special code for non-degree/exchange programs ('NIV', 'NIT' = Tufts Cross-Enrollment, 'WCD', 'CSB'). Referenced by many student, subject, and course tables.

col_002.name: department_name
col_002.description: Full descriptive name of the department or program (e.g. 'Earth, Atmos & Planetary Sci', 'Tufts Cross-Enrollment Prog').

col_003.name: department_code_name
col_003.description: Concatenation of code and name ('12-Earth, Atmos & Planetary Sci'); unique, one-to-one with SIS_DEPARTMENT.col_003, so it mirrors the SIS department identifier.

col_004.name: school_code
col_004.description: Single-letter code for the school/area grouping the department belongs to: E = Engineering, H = Humanities/Arts/Social Sciences, S = Science, Z = Non-MIT, Y = MIT academic (e.g. Schwarzman College), T = Whitaker College of HST. Pairs with col_005.

col_005.name: school_name
col_005.description: Name of the school/area grouping corresponding to col_004 (Engineering; Hum, Arts & Social Sciences; Science; Non-MIT; MIT, academic; Schwarzman Coll of Comp; Whitaker Coll of HST).

table.name: STUDENT_ETHNIC_SUBGROUP
table.purpose: Lookup table mapping student ethnic/race categories (federal IPEDS-style codes) to their detailed subgroups. Each row is one subgroup within a race/ethnicity category, keyed by a composite code 'race_code:subgroup_code'. The col_004 join to SPACE_USAGE is spurious (coincidental numeric overlap), not a real relationship.

col_001.name: ethnic_subgroup_key
col_001.description: Primary key: composite code of race category code and subgroup code, e.g. '50:5001' = Asian:Chinese.

col_002.name: race_ethnicity_category
col_002.description: Broad race/ethnicity category label (Asian, Hispanic or Latino, Black or African American, etc.), corresponding to the code in col_004.

col_003.name: subgroup_description
col_003.description: Detailed subgroup within the race category: either a specific ethnicity/nationality (China, Puerto Rico, Spain, Sioux, African) or a generic label ('Other', or the category name itself when no subgroup applies).

col_004.name: race_ethnicity_code
col_004.description: Two-digit code for the broad race/ethnicity category (10=Black or African American, 20=American Indian or Alaskan Native, 30=Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander, 40=Hispanic or Latino, 50=Asian, etc.). The accepted join to SPACE_USAGE.col_001 is coincidental numeric overlap, not a real reference.

col_005.name: subgroup_code
col_005.description: Four-digit code for the specific subgroup, prefixed by its category code (1004 within 10, 5001 within 50).

col_006.name: last_updated_date
col_006.description: Date the row was last updated or extracted, formatted DD-MON-YY; all rows show 19-DEC-24, suggesting a snapshot date. Tentative: it could also be a data-load/refresh date rather than a per-row update date, since every row shares the same value.

table.name: SUBJECT_ATTRIBUTE
table.purpose: Lookup/dimension table of MIT subject (course) attribute codes; each row is one attribute code with its description, active flag, and effective dates. Referenced by course catalog tables (DRUPAL_COURSE_CATALOG, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED, CIS_COURSE_CATALOG).

col_001.name: attribute_code
col_001.description: Primary key: short code identifying a subject attribute (e.g. HASS, REST, Institute Lab, cross-registration flags). Values like BIOL, CAL1, ZK, NHCR are MIT subject attribute codes.

col_002.name: active_flag
col_002.description: Whether the attribute is active; 'A' (active, 94 rows) vs 'N' (inactive, 10 rows). Joins to SIS_SUBJECT_CODE code columns.

col_003.name: short_label
col_003.description: Short/abbreviated label for the attribute (e.g. 'HASS-A', 'Institute Lab', 'Half REST Ex'). Null for ~39% of rows, likely where no short form exists. Alternative reading: could be a display label used in the catalog UI rather than an abbreviation.

col_004.name: description
col_004.description: Full description/title of the attribute (e.g. 'HUM-D, Film and Media Studies', 'Not for Cross Reg Harvard', 'Spring Core, Sloan Masters').

col_006.name: effective_date
col_006.description: Date the attribute record became effective (stored as DD-MON-YY text), ranging from 1993 to 2022.

col_007.name: last_extract_date
col_007.description: Date the record was last refreshed/loaded into the warehouse; constant '19-DEC-24' across all rows, suggesting a snapshot/extract date rather than a per-row business date. Alternative reading: could be an 'expired/last active' date, but the constant value favors an extract timestamp.

table.name: SUBJECT_ENROLLABLE
table.purpose: Per-term listing of subjects (courses) that are open for enrollment, with term code, subject code, title, and several constant/placeholder administrative fields. Likely a snapshot extract from a course enrollment system (values suggest a single-source feed, e.g. NIH-labeled extract, dated 19-DEC-24).

col_001.name: term_code
col_001.description: Academic term code in the form YYYY + FA/SP (e.g. 2012FA = Fall 2012). References ACADEMIC_TERMS / ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.

col_002.name: subject_code
col_002.description: Subject identifier in DEPT.NNNN format (e.g. HAA.0677); the specific course/subject within the term. No accepted joins detected, but format matches subject codes used elsewhere (e.g. SIS_SUBJECT_CODE).

col_003.name: subject_title
col_003.description: Human-readable course title, often including department and number (e.g. 'Mathematics 235', 'VES 50: Filmmaking').

col_004.name: subject_title_duplicate
col_004.description: Exact duplicate of col_003 (same distinct count, same top/sample values) - a second copy of the course title.

col_007.name: subject_code_list
col_007.description: Comma-separated list of subject codes (HAA.NNNN, ...), varying only by term - appears to be the full list of enrollable subject codes for that term, repeated on each row of the term. Plausible reading: a per-term aggregate list; alternatively a list of related/linked subjects.

col_008.name: source_system
col_008.description: Constant 'NIH' in all rows. Likely a source/extract system or institution tag, but the exact meaning is not verifiable from the data.

col_010.name: term_guid
col_010.description: Opaque 32-char hex key, one distinct value per term (6 values matching the 6 terms of col_001) - an internal surrogate/GUID key for the academic term.

col_011.name: extract_date
col_011.description: Constant date '19-DEC-24' in all rows - the date the snapshot/extract was generated (DD-MON-YY format).

table.name: SUBJECT_GROUPING
table.purpose: Per-term mapping of MIT course subject/department codes to their owning academic department and school grouping; likely a snapshot of subject-to-department assignments by academic term, extracted on 19-DEC-24.

col_001.name: row_id
col_001.description: Synthetic primary key; opaque hex surrogate IDs (some legacy composite keys like '1994SP66.196' appear). No joins detected.

col_002.name: academic_term_code
col_002.description: Academic term in MIT format YYYY + session (FA/SP/SU/JA), e.g. 2022SP, 2001JA (IAP). References ACADEMIC_TERMS.

col_003.name: department_code
col_003.description: MIT course/department code (e.g. 15=Management, 6=EECS, MAS=Media Arts & Sciences, NIV, SEM).

col_004.name: department_name
col_004.description: Department name corresponding to the code (e.g. 'Management', 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci').

col_005.name: department_code_name
col_005.description: Concatenated code-name (e.g. '15-Management'); joins to SIS_DEPARTMENT.

col_006.name: school_grouping
col_006.description: School/area grouping of the department (Engineering, Science, Hum Arts & Social Sciences, Architecture and Planning, Sloan, plus special values like Non-MIT, MIT non-academic, HST, Schwarzman College).

col_007.name: extract_date
col_007.description: Snapshot/extract date, constant '19-DEC-24' across all rows.

table.name: SUBJECT_IAP_SCHEDULE
table.purpose: Meeting/session schedule for MIT Independent Activities Period (January 2021) non-credit subjects: each row is one scheduled session of an IAP activity, with its date, start and end times, and location/online-access details. Related to IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION/IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL tables. The table appears to be a snapshot extract (all rows share the same term code and load date).

col_001.name: term_code
col_001.description: Academic term code, '2021JA' = January/IAP term 2021. Constant across all rows; likely matches ACADEMIC_TERMS term codes.

col_004.name: location
col_004.description: Meeting location or delivery mode, free-form: mostly 'Zoom'/'Virtual'/'Online' (pandemic-era remote IAP), with case variants. Null ~10% (likely in-person or unspecified).

col_005.name: start_time
col_005.description: Session start time in HHMMAM/PM format (e.g. 0100PM = 1:00 PM).

col_006.name: end_time
col_006.description: Session end time in HHMMAM/PM format (e.g. 0300PM = 3:00 PM).

col_008.name: session_date
col_008.description: Date of the session, DD-MON-YY format, all in January 2021 (IAP).

col_009.name: registration_or_access_note
col_009.description: Free-text note on how to join/register: Zoom links, registration URLs (Handshake, Google Forms), or 'link sent by email'.

col_010.name: load_date
col_010.description: Data load/extract date, constant '19-DEC-24' on all rows; a warehouse snapshot timestamp, not a session attribute.

table.name: SUBJECT_OFFERED

This extract contains only Harvard Arts and Sciences (HAA) subjects offered via the Harvard Cross-Enrollment Program (non-MIT courses available to MIT students). The key pattern is school code + catalog number + term code (e.g. HAA.52432014JA = Harvard subject 5243, spring 2014).

col_001.name: offering_key_no_dots
col_001.description: Primary key: compact form of the subject-offering identifier, concatenating school code (HAA), 4-digit catalog number, 4-digit year, and term (JA = January/spring, SU = summer). E.g. HAA52430002014JA = HAA.5243, 2014JA.

col_002.name: offering_key
col_002.description: Same subject-offering identifier in dotted form: school.catalogNumbertYearTerm, e.g. HAA.52432014JA. Unique per row; alternate primary key representation.

col_003.name: school_term_key_no_dots
col_003.description: School + term identifier without a catalog number (HAA00000002014JA); groups all offerings of the school in one term. Joins conceptually to col_004.

col_004.name: school_term_key
col_004.description: Dotted school + term key, HAA.00002014JA; identifies the offering's school and academic term.

col_005.name: term_code
col_005.description: Academic term code: 4-digit year + JA (January/spring term) or SU (summer). References ACADEMIC_TERMS / ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.

col_006.name: school_code
col_006.description: Offering school code; constant 'HAA' (Harvard, Arts and Sciences) in this extract.

col_007.name: school_code_repeat
col_007.description: Duplicate of the school code column (HAA); likely a second copy of the owning-school code.

col_008.name: school_name
col_008.description: Name of the offering school; constant 'Harvard, Arts and Sciences'.

col_009.name: school_id_dotted
col_009.description: Dotted school-level identifier 'HAA.0000' (school code with zero catalog number); identifies the school itself.

col_010.name: school_id_dotted_repeat
col_010.description: Duplicate of col_009 (HAA.0000); second copy of the school identifier.

col_011.name: school_code_repeat2
col_011.description: Third copy of the school code (HAA); likely the code of the school that owns the catalog listing, but with no variation or join evidence the specific role cannot be confirmed.

col_012.name: school_code_repeat3
col_012.description: Fourth copy of the school code (HAA); likely the code of the school offering the subject, but with no variation or join evidence the specific role cannot be confirmed.

col_013.name: school_name_repeat
col_013.description: Duplicate of the school name ('Harvard, Arts and Sciences'); second copy, probably the offering school's name.

col_014.name: subject_id
col_014.description: Dotted subject (catalog) identifier, school code + catalog number, e.g. HAA.5243. Identifies the course independent of term; ~2081 distinct Harvard courses.

col_015.name: subject_id_repeat
col_015.description: Duplicate of col_014 (HAA.xxxx); second copy of the subject identifier.

col_016.name: subject_title
col_016.description: Course title as offered, e.g. 'English 10b:British Writers II', 'Historical Study A-13:China'. Truncated to ~30 chars.

col_018.name: offered_flag
col_018.description: Y/N flag, always 'Y'. Plausibly indicates the subject is offered/active, but with no variation the specific meaning cannot be confirmed.

col_023.name: exchange_program_code
col_023.description: Constant 'NIH' — code of the external/cross-registration program under which these subjects are offered. Exact expansion of the code is not evidenced.

col_024.name: exchange_program_name
col_024.description: Constant 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' — name of the cross-enrollment program offering these subjects.

col_025.name: mit_non_mit_indicator
col_025.description: Constant 'Non-MIT' — indicates these subjects are not MIT subjects (offered by an external institution).

col_030.name: subject_group_code
col_030.description: Constant 'S' — code for the subject grouping; pairs with col_031 ('SWE: School-Wide Electives').

col_031.name: subject_group_name
col_031.description: Constant 'SWE: School-Wide Electives' — name/label of the subject grouping these offerings belong to.

col_033.name: graduate_level_code

col_034.name: graduate_level_description
col_034.description: Plain-text expansion of col_033: 'Not for graduate credit', 'Graduate program', 'Higher level graduate program'.

col_043.name: term_guid
col_043.description: Hex GUID identifying the academic term; one distinct value per term (27 values matching the 27 term codes). Internal surrogate key for the term.

col_044.name: last_extract_date
col_044.description: Constant date '19-DEC-24' — plausibly the date the data was loaded/extracted into the warehouse, though it could also be a last-refresh or effective date; no join evidence to confirm.

col_046.name: offering_key_repeat
col_046.description: Duplicate of col_002: dotted subject-offering identifier (HAA.xxxxYYYYTT), unique per row.

table.name: SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY

col_001.name: offering_id
col_001.description: Primary key: subject code + term code (e.g. HAA.24922014FA = subject HAA.2492, Fall 2014).

col_002.name: parent_offering_id
col_002.description: Key of a related/parent offering, usually the umbrella subject for the term (e.g. HAA.00002014FA for a Harvard cross-enrollment section). col_003.name: term_code
col_003.description: Academic term code: 4-digit year + FA/SP/JA/SU (Fall, Spring, January IAP, Summer). References ACADEMIC_TERMS.

col_004.name: subject_prefix
col_004.description: Subject code prefix / course number (department code, e.g. HAA, 14, 18). References SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.

col_005.name: subject_code
col_005.description: Full subject code without term (e.g. 14.383, HAA.2492).

col_006.name: subject_code_padded
col_006.description: Same subject code as col_005 but space-padded (right-aligned numeric codes).

col_007.name: subject_title

col_008.name: base_subject_code

col_009.name: base_subject_code_2

col_011.name: offering_type_description
col_011.description: Label for col_010: 'SWE: School-Wide Electives', 'Meeting Together', 'Joint subject'.

col_012.name: meeting_together_subjects
col_012.description: Comma-separated list of subject codes that meet together with this offering (joint/meeting-together subjects).

col_013.name: graduate_level_code
col_013.description: Graduate credit level code: H = Higher level graduate program, N = Not for graduate credit, G = Graduate program.

col_014.name: graduate_level_description
col_014.description: Label for col_013.

col_015.name: department_code
col_015.description: Owning/administrative department code (e.g. NIH = Harvard Cross-Enrollment, 15 = Management). References STUDENT_DEPARTMENT / SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.

col_016.name: department_name
col_016.description: Department name label for col_015.

col_017.name: school
col_017.description: MIT school of the department (Engineering, Science, Hum Arts & Social Sciences, Sloan, Non-MIT, etc.).

col_018.name: instructor_name
col_018.description: Instructor name (Last, First). Null for most cross-enrollment rows; the top value 'Downs, Francesco' with 1127 rows matches the HAA.00002016SP umbrella, so it may be a placeholder/primary-contact instructor. Alternative reading: it could be the lead instructor of record rather than any placeholder.

col_019.name: instructor_id
col_019.description: Instructor MIT ID (9-digit), paired with col_018. Alternative reading: it could be some other person/role identifier, but the pairing with the instructor name column makes the instructor-ID reading most plausible.

col_020.name: total_credit_units
col_020.description: Total credit units for the subject (MIT units, typically 12, 6, or multiples; max 24).

col_021.name: lecture_units
col_021.description: Lecture hours/units per week component of total units. Alternative reading: it could be a different unit breakdown (e.g. lecture+recitation combined), but the standard MIT units format (lecture-lab-prep) supports this reading.

col_022.name: lab_or_design_units
col_022.description: Lab/design (or recitation) units component; lecture + this + col_023 roughly sum to total units. Alternative reading: it could be lab only or design only rather than a combined lab/design component.

col_023.name: preparation_units
col_023.description: Preparation/homework units component of total units. Alternative reading: it could be an independent-study or 'other' unit component, but the MIT lecture-lab-prep convention supports preparation.

col_024.name: enrollment_total
col_024.description: Total enrollment count in the offering (0 for most cross-enrollment rows, up to 432).

col_025.name: enrollment_cross_registered
col_025.description: Enrollment count for cross-enrolled (Harvard/Wellesley) students; null when not a cross-enrollment offering. Value 190 repeated 1127 times matches the HAA.00002016SP umbrella row, likely a placeholder. col_026.name: snapshot_date
col_026.description: Data as-of date the summary was generated: 19-DEC-24 (constant).

table.name: TIME_MONTH
table.purpose: A fiscal-month time dimension (date-conformed dimension) for a July-June fiscal year (MIT-style). One row per fiscal period per fiscal year (16 periods per year, periods 13-16 being June closing/adjustment periods), covering FY1996-FY2035. It carries both fiscal keys (fiscal year, period, quarter) and calendar attributes (calendar month/year, month start/end dates), plus mappings to academic terms and financial-aid years. Referenced by facility history tables (FCLT_*_HIST) and fiscal period tables (FRC_FISCAL_PERIODS).

col_001.name: is_closing_period
col_001.description: Y/N flag marking fiscal closing (adjustment) periods. Y for 160 rows = 4 per fiscal year (periods 13-16, the June closing periods); sample row for period 202816 ('June 2028 Closing') is Y.

col_002.name: fiscal_period_label
col_002.description: Human-readable label of the fiscal period: 'YYYYPP -- Month YYYY' (e.g. '200005 -- November 1999'), unique per row.

col_003.name: is_final_closing_period
col_003.description: Y/N flag, Y for exactly 16 rows (one per fiscal year). Since each fiscal year has four June closing periods (13-16), the most plausible reading is that it marks the final closing period (period 16) of each fiscal year; an alternative reading is some other once-per-year special period. Evidence does not fully disambiguate.

col_004.name: fiscal_period_key
col_004.description: Fiscal period key in the form YYYYPP where YYYY is the fiscal year and PP the fiscal period number (01 = July ... 16 = June closing). Primary identifier of the row; referenced by FCLT_*_HIST tables and TIME_QUARTER.

col_005.name: fiscal_period_key_2
col_005.description: Duplicate of col_004 (identical values and join profile): fiscal period key YYYYPP. Likely a redundant copy of the key.

col_006.name: fiscal_period_name
col_006.description: Display name of the fiscal period, e.g. 'FY 2000 Period 5', 'FY 2028 closing period 4'.

col_007.name: fiscal_year
col_007.description: Fiscal year (1996-2035), 16 periods per year.

col_008.name: fiscal_quarter_name
col_008.description: Fiscal quarter display name, e.g. 'FY 2000 Quarter 2'; references TIME_QUARTER.

col_009.name: fiscal_quarter_code
col_009.description: Compact fiscal quarter code, e.g. 'FY2000Q2'; references TIME_QUARTER.

col_010.name: calendar_month_key
col_010.description: Calendar month key YYYYMM of the period's calendar month (e.g. 199911 for FY2000 period 5), with a 'Pnn' suffix for closing periods (e.g. '201706P13', '202806P16').

col_011.name: calendar_month_label
col_011.description: Calendar month label, e.g. 'November 1999', 'June 2028, fiscal period 16' for closing periods.

col_012.name: calendar_year
col_012.description: Calendar year of the period's month (1995-2035).

col_013.name: month_start_date
col_013.description: First day of the period's calendar month, in DD-MON-YY format (e.g. '01-NOV-99').

col_014.name: month_end_date
col_014.description: Last day of the period's calendar month, in DD-MON-YY format (e.g. '30-NOV-99', '29-FEB-00').

col_015.name: calendar_month_number
col_015.description: Calendar month number 1-12 (sample: FY2000 period 5 = November = 11). June (6) has 200 rows because the four closing periods 13-16 also fall in June.

col_016.name: calendar_month_name
col_016.description: Calendar month name (January-December).

col_017.name: is_current_period
col_017.description: Y/N flag with exactly one Y row. Most plausibly marks the current (as-of-load) fiscal period; alternatively it could mark some other single special period. No join evidence disambiguates.

col_018.name: is_current_period_2
col_018.description: Y/N flag with exactly one Y row, same profile as col_017. Likely a second 'current/special period' flag (possibly current calendar month vs. current fiscal period, or a copy of col_017). Exact meaning unresolved.

col_019.name: academic_year
col_019.description: Academic (term) year the month maps to (e.g. 2000 for Fall Term 1999-2000); null for months not in an academic term (12.2% null).

col_020.name: academic_term_code
col_020.description: Academic term code (e.g. '2000FA', '2022SP', '2028SU'); references ACADEMIC_TERMS / ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.

col_021.name: academic_term_name
col_021.description: Academic term display name, e.g. 'Fall Term 1999-2000', 'Summer Term 2028'; references ACADEMIC_TERMS.

col_022.name: aid_year

col_023.name: aid_year_label
col_023.description: Financial-aid year display label, e.g. 'Aid Year 1999-2000'.

table.name: TIME_QUARTER
table.purpose: A date-dimension (time hierarchy) table at quarterly grain: one row per fiscal quarter from FY2000 through FY2035 (144 quarters). The fiscal year runs July 1 - June 30 (MIT-style), so fiscal Q2 (Oct-Dec) of FY2004 maps to calendar Q4 2003. It is referenced by TIME_MONTH, which rolls months up to quarters.

col_001.name: fiscal_year
col_001.description: Fiscal year of the quarter, e.g. 2004 for FY2004Q2 (Oct-Dec 2003). Ranges 2000-2035, four quarters per year.

col_002.name: fiscal_quarter_key
col_002.description: Primary key. Compact fiscal quarter code, e.g. FY2004Q2. Referenced by TIME_MONTH (month-to-quarter rollup).

col_003.name: fiscal_quarter_label
col_003.description: Human-readable fiscal quarter label, e.g. 'FY 2004 Quarter 2'.

col_004.name: calendar_quarter_code
col_004.description: Corresponding calendar quarter code, e.g. CY2003Q4 for FY2004Q2, confirming the July-June fiscal year.

col_005.name: calendar_quarter_label
col_005.description: Human-readable calendar quarter label, e.g. 'CY 2003 Quarter 4'.

col_006.name: calendar_year
col_006.description: Calendar year in which the quarter's months fall (1999-2035); e.g. 2003 for FY2004Q2.

col_007.name: quarter_start_date
col_007.description: First calendar date of the quarter, DD-MON-YY (e.g. 01-OCT-03).

col_008.name: quarter_end_date
col_008.description: Last calendar date of the quarter, DD-MON-YY (e.g. 31-DEC-03).

col_009.name: fiscal_month_start
col_009.description: First fiscal month of the quarter as YYYY+fiscal-month-number (fiscal month 1 = July). E.g. 200404 = FY2004 month 4 (October 2003). Joins one-to-one to TIME_MONTH month keys.

col_010.name: fiscal_month_end
col_010.description: Last fiscal month of the quarter in the same YYYYMM fiscal numbering, e.g. 200406 = FY2004 month 6 (December 2003).

col_011.description: A date in DD-MON-YY format. For FY2004Q2 (Oct-Dec 2003) it is 01-JAN-04, i.e. it does not fall inside the quarter. It appears to be the start of the quarter that begins three months later (or the first date of a Jan-Mar aligned quarter), but the evidence does not uniquely determine the intended meaning.

col_013.description: A date identical in distribution to col_008 (quarter end, e.g. 31-MAR-04 for FY2004Q2). Likely the end date of the following quarter (Jan-Mar 2004), but the offset intent is unclear.

col_014.name: is_current_quarter
col_014.description: Y/N flag; exactly one row is Y, consistent with marking the quarter containing the load date (Dec 2024, FY2025Q2).

col_017.name: is_past_or_current
col_017.description: Y/N flag; Y for 101 rows, matching the count of quarters from FY2000Q1 through the current quarter at load time - likely 'quarter has begun / is in the past or present'.

col_018.name: is_future
col_018.description: Y/N flag; Y for 42 rows, exactly the complement of col_017 (144-101=42 future quarters) - likely 'quarter is in the future'.

col_019.name: fiscal_year_quarter
col_019.description: Fiscal year plus quarter number as YYYYQQ, e.g. 200402 for FY2004Q2; unique per row.

col_020.name: load_date
col_020.description: Constant 20-DEC-24 on every row - the date the dimension was generated/loaded.

table.name: TIP_DETAIL
table.purpose: One row per course material (textbook/reading) per subject per academic term, from MIT's Textbook Information Project (TIP). Records the material status code, ISBN, and term for each subject offering, with a snapshot/extract date.

col_001.name: SUBJECT_TERM_KEY

col_002.name: MATERIAL_DESCRIPTION

col_003.name: MATERIAL_STATUS_CODE
col_003.description: Code describing the textbook/material requirement status for the subject, referencing TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS. Known values: RQ (required, most common), NM (course has no materials), EO (likely 'elective/optional' or 'exam only' - exact label not shown), RC (likely 'recommended choice' - not confirmed), U (unknown), NL, BR (bookstore recommends), CL (go to class first).

col_004.name: TERM_CODE
col_004.description: Academic term code in MIT format: 4-digit year plus session suffix (SP spring, FA fall, SU summer, JA January/IAP). References ACADEMIC_TERMS.

col_005.name: SUBJECT_NUMBER

col_006.name: ISBN
col_006.description: ISBN of the course material, stored as text (mostly ISBN-13 values beginning 978..., some ISBN-10 or other book numbers). Null when the course has no materials; '0' when unknown. The numeric statistics are artifacts of parsing these codes as numbers and should be ignored.

col_007.name: ACTIVE_FLAG
col_007.description: Constant value 1 on every row; likely an active/current-record flag. Its exact meaning cannot be confirmed since it never varies.

col_008.name: EXTRACT_DATE
col_008.description: Constant snapshot date '20-DEC-24' on all rows: the date this extract of the table was generated/loaded.

table.name: TIP_MATERIAL

col_001.name: MATERIAL_KEY
col_001.description: Primary key: concatenation of ISBN (or 0 when absent), abbreviated title, edition, and term code (e.g. '2021FA', '2023SP'). Uniquely identifies a material assigned in a given term.

col_002.name: ISBN
col_002.description: ISBN-13 of the material; 0 or blank when no ISBN exists (e.g. Coop or custom items).

col_003.name: TITLE

col_005.name: EDITION

col_006.name: PUBLISHER

col_007.name: PUBLICATION_YEAR

col_012.name: SOURCE
col_012.description: Code for where the material record came from: ISBN (ISBN.org lookup), COOP (MIT Coop bookstore), OTI (likely Open Textbook Initiative / other source).

table.name: TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS
table.purpose: Lookup table of course material status codes used by the TIP (Textbook/Training Information Program?) course material system; each row maps a two-letter status code to its description. Referenced by TIP_DETAIL.

col_001.name: material_status_code
col_001.description: Primary key: two-letter code identifying the course material status (e.g. BR = Bookstore recommends, NM = Course has no materials, NL = no label). Referenced by TIP_DETAIL.col_003.

col_004.name: extract_date
col_004.description: Date the row was loaded/extracted; constant '20-DEC-24' across all rows, likely the warehouse snapshot date. Alternative reading: it could be a generic effective/last-updated date column that merely happens to hold one value in this extract.

col_002.name: term_code

col_003.name: is_enrollable_flag

col_004.name: subject_code

col_005.name: subject_code_padded

col_007.name: subject_number

col_008.name: subject_number_repeat
