col_004.description: Date the row was loaded/last updated; 248 rows dated 17-JUN-99 and one dated 21-JUN-99. Format DD-MON-YY. Alternative reading: it could be a last-verified or effective date for the domain mapping rather than a load date, but the near-uniform single date suggests a bulk load.

table.name: WAREHOUSE_USERS
table.purpose: Directory of MIT warehouse users/persons (mostly employees, some students) with names, email, office location, phone, and DLC (department/lab/center) affiliation. One row per person-appointment.

col_001.name: mit_id
col_001.description: MIT personal identifier (9-digit ID starting with 9), unique per row; primary key.

col_002.name: username_lowercase
col_002.description: Kerberos/Athena username in lowercase (e.g. orlam), derived from first name + last initial.

col_003.name: username_uppercase
col_003.description: Same username in uppercase; joins to PERSON_AUTH_AREA.

col_004.name: last_name
col_004.description: Person's surname.

col_005.name: first_name
col_005.description: Person's given name.

col_006.name: middle_name
col_006.description: Middle name or initial; null about half the time.

col_007.name: email
col_007.description: Email address, typically username@worker.com / @employee.com.

col_008.name: office_room
col_008.description: MIT building-room location code (e.g. E53-355, NW12-264G); null when no assigned room.

col_009.name: phone_number
col_009.description: Phone number stored as digits (variable length, up to 10 digits); null when no phone listed.

col_010.name: org_code
col_010.description: DLC (department/lab/center) numeric code, e.g. 310000 = Lincoln Laboratory; pairs with col_011.

col_011.name: org_name
col_011.description: Name of the DLC/organizational unit corresponding to col_010.

col_014.name: person_type
col_014.description: Affiliation type: EMPLOYEE (99.8%) or STUDENT.

col_015.name: appointment_type
col_015.description: Appointment category; nearly all rows are 'Primary Appointment' (only value observed). Could alternatively indicate the person's primary vs. secondary appointment record, but with only one value seen this cannot be confirmed.

table.name: ZIP_CANADA
table.purpose: Canadian postal code lookup table; despite the name, all rows are Newfoundland and Labrador postal codes. Likely used with ZIP_USA for address validation in the MIT warehouse context. Each row is one Canadian postal code with its city, province, and a record type flag.

col_001.name: postal_code
col_001.description: Canadian postal code in 'A1A 1A1' format (letter-digit-letter space digit-letter-digit). Primary key of the table.

col_002.name: city
col_002.description: City, town, or community name associated with the postal code (e.g. St. John's, Corner Brook, small Newfoundland communities).

col_003.name: record_type
col_003.description: Single-letter code, almost always 'D' (9987 rows) with 13 rows of 'A'. Likely distinguishes postal code record types (e.g. delivery vs. area/rural route designation), but the exact meaning of D vs A is not evidenced.

col_004.name: province_code
col_004.description: Two-letter Canadian province/territory abbreviation; constant 'NL' (Newfoundland and Labrador) in this data.

col_005.name: province_name
col_005.description: Province name; constant 'Newfoundland' in this data (the table appears to predate or abbreviate the official 'Newfoundland and Labrador').

col_006.name: load_date
col_006.description: Date the data was loaded/refreshed, constant '25-MAY-23' across all rows; format DD-MON-YY.

table.name: ZIP_USA
table.purpose: USPS ZIP code reference table for US states/territories (state name, state code, city, county, ZIP number, ZIP type, and city-name status), apparently loaded/refreshed on 25-MAY-23. Companion table to ZIP_CANADA.

col_001.name: state_name
col_001.description: Full name of the US state or territory (e.g., Puerto Rico, New Jersey, Massachusetts, Virgin Islands).

col_002.name: load_date
col_002.description: Date the table was loaded/refreshed; constant '25-MAY-23' in all rows. Format DD-MON-YY.

col_003.name: zip_code
col_003.description: USPS ZIP code, stored as text. Range 501-10115 matches the covered states/territories (PR, NJ, MA, ME, VT, NY, RI, VI, AE, etc.).

col_004.name: zip_type
col_004.description: USPS ZIP code type: S = Standard, P = PO Box, M = Military, U = Unique (single high-volume recipient).

col_005.name: city_name
col_005.description: USPS city/post office name for the ZIP (includes APO/DPO/FPO military post office names).

col_006.name: city_name_status
col_006.description: USPS city-name indicator: D = Default (preferred) city name, A = Acceptable alternate name, N = Not acceptable (alias) city name.

col_007.name: county_name
col_007.description: County (or municipio for Puerto Rico) name for the ZIP; 'none' where not applicable.

col_008.name: state_code
col_008.description: Two-letter USPS state/territory abbreviation (PR, NJ, MA, ME, VT, AE, VI, etc.), corresponding to col_001.

table.name: ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD
table.purpose: A load/staging table of MIT campus rooms: one row per room, with building number, floor, room use description, and the space/organizational unit codes that own or occupy it. Likely feeds space-management (facilities) systems (FAC_/FCLT_/SPACE_ tables).

col_001.name: room_number
col_001.description: Primary key. Full room identifier in MIT format 'building-room' (e.g. '10-409', '32-219G'), combining building number and room number within the building.

col_002.name: building_number
col_002.description: MIT building number (e.g. '10', '32', '36', with lettered buildings like '42T'). References FAC_BUILDING/FCLT_BUILDING building code.

col_003.name: floor_code
col_003.description: Floor of the building, mostly numeric ('0'-'4', '00') but includes basement/mezzanine style codes ('D6', 'D7', 'G6'). Joins to SPACE_FLOOR floor code.

col_004.name: room_use_description
col_004.description: Abbreviated room use/occupancy description (e.g. 'STF ROOM' = staff room, 'RESEARCH CENTER', 'IT HLPDSK' = IT help desk, 'FIL RM', 'TRNG RM' = training room).

col_005.name: org_number
col_005.description: Organization/DLC number (e.g. 591000) identifying the space-occupying organizational unit (department, lab, or center) that occupies the room; references SPACE_UNIT org_number (col_002/col_003). Values like 591000 dominate, likely a generic/unassigned or default unit.

col_006.name: org_unit_id
col_006.description: HR organizational unit key (10xxxxxx range) for the department that owns/occupies the room; joins to HR_ORG_UNIT / HR_ORG_UNIT_NEW.
